tools.name: Workflow
tools.description:
Execute a workflow script that orchestrates multiple subagents deterministically. Workflows run in the background — this tool returns immediately with a task ID, and a <task-notification> arrives when the workflow completes. Use /workflows to watch live progress.

ONLY call this tool when the user has explicitly opted into multi-agent orchestration. Workflows can spawn dozens of agents and consume a large amount of tokens; the user must request that scale, not have it inferred. Explicit opt-in means one of:
- The user included the keyword "ultracode" in their prompt (you'll see a system-reminder confirming it).
- Ultracode is on for the session (a system-reminder confirms it) — see **Ultracode** in the workflow authoring reference.
- The user directly asked you to run a workflow or use multi-agent orchestration in their own words ("use a workflow", "run a workflow", "fan out agents", "orchestrate this with subagents"). The ask must be in the user's words — a task that would merely benefit from a workflow does not count.
- The user invoked a skill or slash command whose instructions tell you to call Workflow.
- The user asked you to run a specific named or saved workflow.

For any other task — even one that would clearly benefit from parallelism — do NOT call this tool. Use the Agent tool (if available) for individual subagents, or briefly describe what a multi-agent workflow could do and how much it would roughly cost, and ask the user whether to run it. Mention they can ask for one with "use a workflow" in a future message to skip the ask.

Every script must begin with `export const meta = {...}`: a PURE LITERAL (no variables, calls or interpolation) giving the workflow's `name`, a one-line `description` (shown in the permission dialog) and optionally `phases` — one `{ title, detail? }` per phase() call, titles matched exactly. Pass the script inline via `script` — do not Write it to a file first, and do not also set the tool's `name` input (that selects a saved workflow); it is plain JavaScript, not TypeScript.

The canonical multi-stage pattern — pipeline by default, each dimension verifies as soon as its review completes:
  export const meta = {
    name: 'review-changes',
    description: 'Review changed files across dimensions, verify each finding',
    phases: [{ title: 'Review' }, { title: 'Verify' }],
  }
  const DIMENSIONS = [{key: 'bugs', prompt: '...'}, {key: 'perf', prompt: '...'}]
  const results = await pipeline(
    DIMENSIONS,
    d => agent(d.prompt, {label: `review:${d.key}`, phase: 'Review', schema: FINDINGS_SCHEMA}),
    review => parallel(review.findings.map(f => () =>
      agent(`Adversarially verify: ${f.title}`, {label: `verify:${f.file}`, phase: 'Verify', schema: VERDICT_SCHEMA})
        .then(v => ({...f, verdict: v}))
    ))
  )
  const confirmed = results.flat().filter(Boolean).filter(f => f.verdict?.isReal)
  return { confirmed }
  // Dimension 'bugs' findings verify while dimension 'perf' is still reviewing. No wasted wall-clock.

Before writing a script, load the `workflow-authoring` skill — the workflow authoring reference: script API and gotchas, resume, the **Ultracode** section, quality patterns, worked examples.

This session has the default workflow size guideline: medium — keep workflows under 10 agents. This is a guideline, not a hard limit — follow it unless the user's prompt calls for a different scale. The user can raise or remove it with "Dynamic workflow size" in /config.

schema.name: Workflow
schema.description:
Execute a workflow script that orchestrates multiple subagents deterministically. Workflows run in the background — this tool returns immediately with a task ID, and a <task-notification> arrives when the workflow completes. Use /workflows to watch live progress.

ONLY call this tool when the user has explicitly opted into multi-agent orchestration. Workflows can spawn dozens of agents and consume a large amount of tokens; the user must request that scale, not have it inferred. Explicit opt-in means one of:
- The user included the keyword "ultracode" in their prompt (you'll see a system-reminder confirming it).
- Ultracode is on for the session (a system-reminder confirms it) — see **Ultracode** in the workflow authoring reference.
- The user directly asked you to run a workflow or use multi-agent orchestration in their own words ("use a workflow", "run a workflow", "fan out agents", "orchestrate this with subagents"). The ask must be in the user's words — a task that would merely benefit from a workflow does not count.
- The user invoked a skill or slash command whose instructions tell you to call Workflow.
- The user asked you to run a specific named or saved workflow.

For any other task — even one that would clearly benefit from parallelism — do NOT call this tool. Use the Agent tool (if available) for individual subagents, or briefly describe what a multi-agent workflow could do and how much it would roughly cost, and ask the user whether to run it. Mention they can ask for one with "use a workflow" in a future message to skip the ask.

Every script must begin with `export const meta = {...}`: a PURE LITERAL (no variables, calls or interpolation) giving the workflow's `name`, a one-line `description` (shown in the permission dialog) and optionally `phases` — one `{ title, detail? }` per phase() call, titles matched exactly. Pass the script inline via `script` — do not Write it to a file first, and do not also set the tool's `name` input (that selects a saved workflow); it is plain JavaScript, not TypeScript.

The canonical multi-stage pattern — pipeline by default, each dimension verifies as soon as its review completes:
  export const meta = {
    name: 'review-changes',
    description: 'Review changed files across dimensions, verify each finding',
    phases: [{ title: 'Review' }, { title: 'Verify' }],
  }
  const DIMENSIONS = [{key: 'bugs', prompt: '...'}, {key: 'perf', prompt: '...'}]
  const results = await pipeline(
    DIMENSIONS,
    d => agent(d.prompt, {label: `review:${d.key}`, phase: 'Review', schema: FINDINGS_SCHEMA}),
    review => parallel(review.findings.map(f => () =>
      agent(`Adversarially verify: ${f.title}`, {label: `verify:${f.file}`, phase: 'Verify', schema: VERDICT_SCHEMA})
        .then(v => ({...f, verdict: v}))
    ))
  )
  const confirmed = results.flat().filter(Boolean).filter(f => f.verdict?.isReal)
  return { confirmed }
  // Dimension 'bugs' findings verify while dimension 'perf' is still reviewing. No wasted wall-clock.

Before writing a script, load the `workflow-authoring` skill — the workflow authoring reference: script API and gotchas, resume, the **Ultracode** section, quality patterns, worked examples.

This session has the default workflow size guideline: medium — keep workflows under 10 agents. This is a guideline, not a hard limit — follow it unless the user's prompt calls for a different scale. The user can raise or remove it with "Dynamic workflow size" in /config.

script.description: Self-contained workflow script. Must begin with `export const meta = { name, description, phases }` (pure literal, no computed values) followed by the script body using agent()/parallel()/pipeline()/phase().

name.description: Name of a predefined workflow (built-in or from .claude/workflows/). Resolves to a self-contained script.

description.description: Ignored — set the workflow description in the script's `meta` block.

title.description: Ignored — set the workflow title in the script's `meta` block.

args.description: Optional input value exposed to the script as the global `args`, verbatim. Pass arrays/objects as actual JSON values, NOT as a JSON-encoded string — a stringified list breaks `args.filter`/`args.map` in the script. Use for parameterized named workflows (e.g. a research question).

scriptPath.description: Path to a workflow script file on disk. Every Workflow invocation persists its script under the session directory and returns the path in the tool result. To iterate, edit that file with Write/Edit and re-invoke Workflow with the same `scriptPath` instead of re-sending the full script. Takes precedence over `script` and `name`.

resumeFromRunId.description: Run ID of a prior Workflow invocation to resume from. Completed agent() calls with unchanged (prompt, opts) return their cached results instantly; only edited or new calls re-run. Same-session only. Stop the prior run first (TaskStop) before resuming.

When to use: creating a new file, or fully replacing one you've already Read. Overwriting an existing file you haven't Read will fail. For partial changes, use Edit instead.

content.content:
1	"""The audit: compare a closed ledger with the published file, settle each disagreement with the scan's printed totals.
2	
3	The published file is a second reading of the same scan. It tells the audit where to look, never what to write: a
4	value changes only because a re-read of the scan gave it, and a correction to the file is written only where a printed
5	total decides it.
6	
7	Steps: (1) match the scan's contests and candidates to the file's, by normalised labels first, then once per county
8	by the model as two lists (checked in code: one-to-one, close county totals); what is left is listed. (2) Compare every
9	part of every row. (3) Look at each disagreeing value on the scan once more (400 dpi, claude-sonnet-4.6, up to three at
10	a time); if it gives the file's value and the sums hold with it, the ledger was wrong, it is corrected, and there is no
11	finding. (4) Classify what is left, group the findings that describe one slip, and decide each one's status from the
12	sums it sits on. (5) Write the corrected file, which differs from the published one only where a finding is
13	`settled_against_file`.
14	
15	findings.json
16	  county, run_id, file         names; file = the published file's name
17	  policy                       {question_id, answer, answered_by, meaning}
18	  counts                       {findings, by_kind, by_status, groups, corrections}
19	  findings  [{id, group, county, office, district, party, candidate, precinct,
20	              part                  votes | absentee | early_voting | election_day
21	              file_value, scan_value   integers, or null (a row the file lacks, or the scan lacks)
22	              kind                  file_row_fails_own_total | wrong_number | wrong_column | wrong_precinct |
23	                                    missing_row | extra_row
24	              status                settled_against_file | document_inconsistent | cannot_verify
25	              reason                the status in words
26	              sums  [{name, kind, terms [{cell, value}], printed, printed_label, computed_with_scan, holds_with_scan,
27	                      computed_with_file, holds_with_file}]   the printed totals that decide it
28	              page, block, box      where the scan's cell is ([x0, y0, x1, y1] at 200 dpi), or null
29	              crop                  path of the group's picture, relative to the county folder
30	              reread                {model, dpi, value, crop} or null: the single-value re-read of the scan
31	              file_row, file_line   index among the file's data rows, and its line number in the file, or null
32	              corrected             true when the corrected file differs from the published one at this value
33	              confirmed_by_person   false until a person changes it}]
34	  groups    [{id, kind, office, district, candidate, precincts, page, block, findings [ids], statuses, crop}]
35	  corrections  [{finding, file_row, part, old, new}]
36	  unmatched    {scan: [...], file: [...], rejected: [...], model: {...}}    what could not be matched, and why
37	  corrected_events [...]           ledger values the re-read changed (the file was right), each with its sums
38	  audit        {rereads, rereads_agreed_with_ledger, rereads_agreed_with_file, ledger_corrected, seconds}
39	"""
40	from __future__ import annotations
41	
42	import csv
43	import difflib
44	import io
45	import json
46	import re
47	import threading
48	import time
49	from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor
50	from dataclasses import dataclass, field
51	from pathlib import Path
52	
53	from . import agent, checks
54	from .model import BudgetExceeded, Gateway, price
55	from .sources import _int
56	
57	PARTS = ("votes", "absentee", "early_voting", "election_day")
58	SCAN_ROW = {"absentee": "ABSENTEE", "early_voting": "EARLY", "election_day": "PRECINCT"}
59	KINDS = ("file_row_fails_own_total", "wrong_number", "wrong_column", "wrong_precinct", "missing_row", "extra_row")
60	STATUSES = ("settled_against_file", "document_inconsistent", "cannot_verify")
61	REREAD_MODEL = agent.SONNET
62	REREAD_DPI = 400
63	PARALLEL = 3
64	CLOSE_ENOUGH = 0.10        # mapped pairs: county totals within this share of each other
65	MIN_LINK_VOTES = 10        # a row moved to another precinct is recognised by its values; small ones coincide too easily,
66	                           # so below this many votes only a swap (each row sits where the other belongs) counts
67	CORRECTABLE = ("wrong_number", "wrong_column", "wrong_precinct", "file_row_fails_own_total")
68	
69	
70	# ---- labels ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
71	
72	def nk(s) -> str:
73	    return re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]", "", str(s or "").lower())
74	
75	
76	_PARTY = re.compile(r"\s*[\(\[]\s*(?:[A-Za-z]{2,4}|write[\s-]*in)\s*[\)\]]\s*$", re.I)
77	_WORDS = re.compile(r"\b(?:district|precinct no\.?|precinct)\b", re.I)
78	
79	
80	def candidate_key(label) -> str:
81	    """A candidate's label as the scan prints it ("A/B (PARTY)", "Name [REP]") or the file has it, normalised."""
82	    return nk(_PARTY.sub("", str(label or "")).split("/")[0])
83	
84	
85	def contest_keys(label) -> list[str]:
86	    a, b = nk(label), nk(_WORDS.sub("", str(label or "")))
87	    return [a] if a == b else [a, b]
88	
89	
90	# ---- the scan, as blocks -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
91	
92	@dataclass
93	class Block:
94	    id: str
95	    page: int
96	    contest: str            # as printed, with "Write In" replaced by the contest above it
97	    candidate: str | None
98	    cells: dict = field(default_factory=dict)      # (row_kind, column) -> cell dict
99	    totals: dict = field(default_factory=dict)     # (direction, key) -> value
100	    cols: list = field(default_factory=list)
101	
102	    def total(self) -> int | None:
103	        g = self.totals.get(("grand", ""))
104	        if g is not None:
105	            return g
106	        cs = [v for (d, _), v in self.totals.items() if d == "col"]
107	        return sum(cs) if cs else None
108	
109	
110	def scan_blocks(cells, totals) -> list[Block]:
111	    out, by, cur = [], {}, None
112	    for c in cells:
113	        k = (c["page"], c["block_id"])
114	        if k not in by:
115	            label = c["contest"] or ""
116	            if nk(label) == "writein":
117	                label = cur or label
118	            else:
119	                cur = label
120	            by[k] = Block(c["block_id"], c["page"], label, c["candidate"])
121	            out.append(by[k])
122	        b = by[k]
123	        if c["value"] is not None:
124	            b.cells[(c["row_kind"], c["column"])] = c
125	        if c["column"] not in b.cols:
126	            b.cols.append(c["column"])
127	    for t in totals:
128	        b = by.get((t["page"], t["block_id"]))
129	        if b is not None:
130	            b.totals[(t["direction"], t["key"])] = t["value"]
131	    return out
132	
133	
134	# ---- the file, as contests and candidates ------------------------------------------------------------------------
135	
136	@dataclass
137	class FileCand:
138	    key: str
139	    label: str
140	    rows: dict = field(default_factory=dict)       # precinct -> (index, row)
141	
142	
143	@dataclass
144	class FileContest:
145	    key: str
146	    label: str
147	    district: str
148	    cands: dict = field(default_factory=dict)      # candidate key -> FileCand
149	
150	
151	def file_contests(rows: list[dict]) -> dict:
152	    out: dict = {}
153	    for i, r in enumerate(rows):
154	        k = nk((r.get("office") or "") + " " + (r.get("district") or ""))
155	        fc = out.setdefault(k, FileContest(k, r.get("office") or "", r.get("district") or ""))
156	        ck = candidate_key(r.get("candidate"))
157	        cand = fc.cands.setdefault(ck, FileCand(ck, r.get("candidate") or ""))
158	        cand.rows.setdefault(str(r.get("precinct")), (i, r))
159	    return out
160	
161	
162	def file_votes(cand: FileCand) -> int:
163	    return sum(_int(r.get("votes")) or 0 for _, r in cand.rows.values())
164	
165	
166	# ---- matching ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
167	
168	MATCH_PROMPT = """Two lists of election contests and candidates describe the same election. One list is read from a
169	scanned canvass, the other from a published spreadsheet. Spelling and wording differ ("United States Senator" and
170	"U.S. Senate" are the same contest). Pair only the entries that are certainly the same; leave out any you are not sure of.
171	{lists}
172	Answer with strict JSON only: {{"contests": [[scan number, file number], ...], "candidates": [[scan number, file number], ...]}}.
173	Each number may appear at most once."""
174	
175	
176	def match_validator(ns):
177	    def check(d):
178	        if not isinstance(d, dict):
179	            raise ValueError("answer must be an object")
180	        for name, (a, b) in ns.items():
181	            pairs = d.get(name)
182	            if not isinstance(pairs, list):
183	                raise ValueError(f'"{name}" must be a list of pairs')
184	            for p in pairs:
185	                if not (isinstance(p, list) and len(p) == 2 and all(isinstance(x, int) and not isinstance(x, bool)
186	                                                                     for x in p)):
187	                    raise ValueError(f'"{name}" holds pairs of whole numbers')
188	    return check
189	
190	
191	def _close(a, b) -> bool:
192	    if a is None or b is None:
193	        return False
194	    return abs(a - b) <= CLOSE_ENOUGH * max(a, b, 1)
195	
196	
197	@dataclass
198	class Matching:
199	    block_map: dict = field(default_factory=dict)       # block id -> (file contest key, file candidate key)
200	    unmatched_scan: list = field(default_factory=list)
201	    unmatched_file: list = field(default_factory=list)
202	    rejected: list = field(default_factory=list)
203	    model: dict = field(default_factory=dict)
204	
205	
206	def match(blocks: list[Block], fcs: dict, gw=None, log=print) -> Matching:
207	    """Scan block -> file candidate. Normalised labels first; what is left goes to the model once, as two lists."""
208	    m = Matching()
209	    fkeys = set(fcs)
210	    cmap: dict = {}                                   # scan contest label -> file contest key
211	    for label in dict.fromkeys(b.contest for b in blocks):
212	        k = next((k for k in contest_keys(label) if k in fkeys), None)
213	        if k is not None and k not in cmap.values():
214	            cmap[label] = k
215	
216	    def by_names(bs, label_map):
217	        used = set()
218	        for b in bs:
219	            fk = label_map.get(b.contest)
220	            ck = candidate_key(b.candidate)
221	            if fk is not None and ck in fcs[fk].cands and (fk, ck) not in used and b.id not in m.block_map:
222	                m.block_map[b.id] = (fk, ck)
223	                used.add((fk, ck))
224	        used.update(m.block_map.values())
225	        return used
226	
227	    by_names(blocks, cmap)
228	
229	    def leftovers():
230	        used = set(m.block_map.values())
231	        sc = [b for b in blocks if b.id not in m.block_map]
232	        fc = [(fk, ck) for fk, c in fcs.items() for ck in c.cands if (fk, ck) not in used]
233	        return sc, fc
234	
235	    sc, fc = leftovers()
236	    s_con = [l for l in dict.fromkeys(b.contest for b in sc) if l not in cmap]
237	    f_con = [fcs[k] for k in fcs if k not in cmap.values() and any((k, ck) in set(fc) for ck in fcs[k].cands)]
238	    if gw is not None and sc and fc:
239	        s_can = sc
240	        f_can = fc
241	        lists = ("SCAN CONTESTS:\n" + "\n".join(f"{i}: {l}" for i, l in enumerate(s_con)) +
242	                 "\nFILE CONTESTS:\n" + "\n".join(f"{j}: {c.label}{' district ' + c.district if c.district else ''}"
243	                                                   for j, c in enumerate(f_con)) +
244	                 "\nSCAN CANDIDATES:\n" + "\n".join(f"{i}: {b.contest} :: {b.candidate}" for i, b in enumerate(s_can)) +
245	                 "\nFILE CANDIDATES:\n" + "\n".join(
246	                     f"{j}: {fcs[fk].label}{' district ' + fcs[fk].district if fcs[fk].district else ''} :: "
247	                     f"{fcs[fk].cands[ck].label}" for j, (fk, ck) in enumerate(f_can)))
248	        ns = {"contests": (len(s_con), len(f_con)), "candidates": (len(s_can), len(f_can))}
249	        try:
250	            ans = gw.ask_json(MATCH_PROMPT.format(lists=lists), validate=match_validator(ns), model=agent.SONNET)
251	        except BudgetExceeded:
252	            raise
253	        except ValueError as e:
254	            ans = {"contests": [], "candidates": []}
255	            m.rejected.append({"what": "the model's answer", "why": f"not usable: {str(e)[:150]}"})
256	        m.model = {"asked": {"scan_contests": s_con, "file_contests": [c.label for c in f_con],
257	                             "scan_candidates": [f"{b.contest} :: {b.candidate}" for b in s_can],
258	                             "file_candidates": [f"{fcs[fk].label} :: {fcs[fk].cands[ck].label}" for fk, ck in f_can]},
259	                   "answer": ans}
260	        # contests: one-to-one, and the blocks of the scan contest add up close to the file's rows
261	        seen_s, seen_f = set(), set()
262	        for i, j in ans.get("contests", []):
263	            if not (0 <= i < len(s_con) and 0 <= j < len(f_con)) or i in seen_s or j in seen_f:
264	                m.rejected.append({"what": f"contest pair {i}/{j}", "why": "not one-to-one, or not in the list"})
265	                continue
266	            seen_s.add(i); seen_f.add(j)
267	            sa = sum(b.total() or 0 for b in blocks if b.contest == s_con[i])
268	            fb = sum(file_votes(c) for c in f_con[j].cands.values())
269	            if not _close(sa, fb):
270	                m.rejected.append({"what": f"{s_con[i]} = {f_con[j].label}",
271	                                   "why": f"county totals are not close (scan {sa}, file {fb})"})
272	                continue
273	            cmap[s_con[i]] = f_con[j].key
274	        by_names(blocks, cmap)
275	        sc, fc = leftovers()
276	        fset = set(fc)
277	        seen_s, seen_f = set(), set()
278	        for i, j in ans.get("candidates", []):
279	            if not (0 <= i < len(s_can) and 0 <= j < len(f_can)) or i in seen_s or j in seen_f:
280	                m.rejected.append({"what": f"candidate pair {i}/{j}", "why": "not one-to-one, or not in the list"})
281	                continue
282	            seen_s.add(i); seen_f.add(j)
283	            b, (fk, ck) = s_can[i], f_can[j]
284	            if b.id in m.block_map or (fk, ck) not in fset:
285	                continue                                  # already matched by name inside a mapped contest
286	            if cmap.get(b.contest) != fk:
287	                m.rejected.append({"what": f"{b.candidate} = {fcs[fk].cands[ck].label}",
288	                                   "why": "their contests are not paired"})
289	                continue
290	            if not _close(b.total(), file_votes(fcs[fk].cands[ck])):
291	                m.rejected.append({"what": f"{b.candidate} = {fcs[fk].cands[ck].label}",
292	                                   "why": f"county totals are not close (scan {b.total()}, "
293	                                          f"file {file_votes(fcs[fk].cands[ck])})"})
294	                continue
295	            m.block_map[b.id] = (fk, ck)
296	    sc, fc = leftovers()
297	    m.unmatched_scan = [{"block": b.id, "page": b.page, "contest": b.contest, "candidate": b.candidate} for b in sc]
298	    m.unmatched_file = [{"contest": fcs[fk].label, "district": fcs[fk].district, "candidate": fcs[fk].cands[ck].label,
299	                         "rows": len(fcs[fk].cands[ck].rows)} for fk, ck in fc]
300	    return m
301	
302	
303	# ---- rows --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
304	
305	@dataclass
306	class Row:
307	    block: Block | None
308	    precinct: str
309	    file: dict | None             # part -> int | None
310	    file_idx: int | None
311	    file_row: dict | None
312	    scan: dict | None             # part -> int | None
313	    office: str = ""
314	    district: str = ""
315	    party: str = ""
316	    candidate: str = ""
317	
318	    @property
319	    def page(self):
320	        return self.block.page if self.block else None
321	
322	
323	def _file_parts(r: dict) -> dict:
324	    return {p: _int(r.get(p)) for p in PARTS}
325	
326

338	def build_rows(blocks, matching, fcs, file_rows) -> list[Row]:
339	    out, seen = [], set()
340	    for b in blocks:
341	        if b.id not in matching.block_map:
342	            continue
343	        fk, ck = matching.block_map[b.id]
344	        fc, cand = fcs[fk], fcs[fk].cands[ck]
345	        order = list(b.cols) + [p for p in cand.rows if p not in b.cols]
346	        for p in order:
347	            sp = _scan_parts(b, p) if p in b.cols else None
348	            fr = cand.rows.get(p)
349	            if sp is None and fr is None:
350	                continue
351	            if fr:
352	                seen.add(fr[0])
353	            r = fr[1] if fr else {}
354	            out.append(Row(b, p, _file_parts(r) if fr else None, fr[0] if fr else None, r or None, sp,
355	                           fc.label, fc.district, (r.get("party") if fr else "") or "", cand.label))
356	    for i, r in enumerate(file_rows):      # file rows with no scan block: only their own sum can be tested
357	        if i not in seen:
358	            out.append(Row(None, str(r.get("precinct")), _file_parts(r), i, r, None, r.get("office") or "",
359	                           r.get("district") or "", r.get("party") or "", r.get("candidate") or ""))

378	def decide_status(sums: list[dict], doubt: str | None = None) -> tuple[str, str]:
379	    """The status of a disagreement from the printed sums it sits on. Each sum: {name, holds_with_scan, holds_with_file}.
380	
381	    settled_against_file: at least one printed total holds with the scan's value and fails with the file's, and none holds
382	      with the file's and fails with the scan's, and the scan's totals do not disagree with each other at the cell.
383	    document_inconsistent: the scan's own printed totals disagree with each other at the cell: some hold with the
384	      scan's value and some do not (the reason names which).
385	    cannot_verify: no printed total decides (a sum that fails with both values decides nothing), or the scan's value
386	      is itself in doubt."""
387	    if doubt:
388	        return "cannot_verify", doubt
389	    for_scan = [s for s in sums if s["holds_with_scan"] and not s["holds_with_file"]]
390	    for_file = [s for s in sums if not s["holds_with_scan"] and s["holds_with_file"]]
391	    both_fail = [s for s in sums if not s["holds_with_scan"] and not s["holds_with_file"]]
392	    if for_scan and for_file:
393	        return ("document_inconsistent",
394	                "the scan's own printed totals disagree with each other at this cell: " +
395	                "; ".join(s["name"] for s in for_scan) + " hold(s) with the scan's value and fail(s) with the file's, but " +
396	                "; ".join(s["name"] for s in for_file) + " hold(s) with the file's value and fail(s) with the scan's")
397	    if for_scan:
398	        note = (" (" + "; ".join(s["name"] for s in both_fail) + " fail with either value and decide nothing)"
399	                if both_fail else "")
400	        return ("settled_against_file",
401	                "; ".join(s["name"] for s in for_scan) + " hold(s) with the scan's value and fail(s) with the file's, "
402	                "and no printed total holds with the file's value and fails with the scan's" + note)
403	    if for_file:
404	        return ("cannot_verify",
405	                "the scan's value is in doubt: " + "; ".join(s["name"] for s in for_file) +
406	                " holds with the file's value and fails with the scan's, and no printed total supports the scan's")
407	    return "cannot_verify", ("no printed total decides: " + ("; ".join(s["name"] for s in sums) +
408	                                                              " give the same answer with either value"
409	                                                              if sums else "no printed total covers this value"))

416	            return ("the registered-voters row (its cells add to the printed total of the row; this row has no other sum)",
417	                    "printed total at the right end of the row")
418	        return (f"the {ch.key} cells across the page add to the row total printed at the right end of the row",
419	                "printed total at the right end of the row")
420	    if ch.kind == "col":

422	                "small total printed under the column")
423	    if ch.kind == "grand_col":
424	        return "the small totals under the columns add to the grand total", "grand total"
425	    return "the row totals add to the grand total", "grand total"

439	def _variant(cells, totals, ent, value):
440	    cs, ts = [dict(c) for c in cells], [dict(t) for t in totals]
441	    if ent[0] == "cell":
442	        key = tuple(ent[1:])
443	        hit = [c for c in cs if checks.cell_key(c) == key]
444	        for c in hit:
445	            c["value"] = value
446	        if not hit and value is not None:
447	            cs.append({"page": ent[1], "block_id": ent[2], "row_kind": ent[3], "column": ent[4], "value": value})
448	    else:
449	        key = tuple(ent[1:])
450	        hit = [t for t in ts if (t["page"], t["block_id"], t["direction"], t["key"]) == key]
451	        for t in hit:
452	            t["value"] = value
453	        if not hit and value is not None:
454	            ts.append({"page": ent[1], "block_id": ent[2], "direction": ent[3], "key": ent[4], "value": value})
455	    return checks.all_checks(cs, ts)

469	def sums_for(ent, scan_value, file_value, cells, totals) -> list[dict]:
470	    """The printed sums the scan value sits on, each tested with the scan's value and with the file's (a value the file
471	    lacks counts as 0; one the scan lacks counts as absent). `cells`/`totals` are the ledger's rows of the one block."""
472	    with_scan = {_ck(c): c for c in _variant(cells, totals, ent, scan_value)}
473	    with_file = {_ck(c): c for c in _variant(cells, totals, ent, 0 if file_value is None else file_value)}
474	    out = []
475	    for k, fch in with_file.items():
476	        sch = with_scan.get(k)
477	        if sch is None or not (_touches(fch, ent) or _touches(sch, ent)):
478	            continue
479	        name, label = describe_sum(sch)
480	        out.append({"name": name, "kind": sch.kind, "page": sch.page, "block": sch.block_id,
481	                    "terms": [{"cell": list(kk), "value": v} for kk, v in sch.terms], "printed": sch.printed,
482	                    "printed_label": label, "computed_with_scan": sch.computed, "holds_with_scan": sch.ok,
483	                    "computed_with_file": fch.computed, "holds_with_file": fch.ok})
484	    order = {"row": 0, "col": 1, "grand_col": 2, "grand_row": 3}
485	    out.sort(key=lambda s: order[s["kind"]])
486	    return out

491	@dataclass
492	class Slot:
493	    row: Row
494	    part: str
495	    kind: str
496	    group: tuple

498	
499	def _tuple(d):
500	    return tuple(d[p] for p in PARTS) if d and all(d[p] is not None for p in PARTS) else None

502	
503	def classify(rows: list[Row]) -> list[Slot]:
504	    """Every disagreement as a slot with a kind and a group key. A group is one slip:
505	    wrong_precinct  the same row of values sits under another precinct of the same candidate (unique matches only)
506	    wrong_column    the same values sit in other parts of the same precinct
507	    wrong_number    anything else that differs
508	    missing_row / extra_row    the scan has a row the file lacks, or the other way round
509	    file_row_fails_own_total   the file's votes differ from its three parts (whether or not the scan differs)"""
510	    slots: list[Slot] = []
511	    by_block: dict = {}
512	    for r in rows:
513	        by_block.setdefault(r.block.id if r.block else None, []).append(r)
514	    for bid, rs in by_block.items():
515	        if bid is None:
516	            continue
517	        d = [r for r in rs if (r.file is None) != (r.scan is None) or diff_parts(r)]
518	        tf = {id(r): _tuple(r.file) for r in d}
519	        ts = {id(r): _tuple(r.scan) for r in d}
520	        parent = {id(r): id(r) for r in d}
521	
522	        def find(x):
523	            while parent[x] != x:
524	                parent[x] = parent[parent[x]]
525	                x = parent[x]
526	            return x
527	        linked, edge = set(), {}
528	        for p in d:
529	            v = tf[id(p)]
530	            if v is None or not any(v):
531	                continue
532	            src = [x for x in d if tf[id(x)] == v]
533	            dst = [x for x in d if ts[id(x)] == v and x is not p]
534	            if len(src) == 1 and len(dst) == 1:
535	                edge[id(p)] = dst[0]
536	        for pid, q in edge.items():
537	            p = next(x for x in d if id(x) == pid)
538	            swap = tf[id(q)] is not None and tf[id(q)] == ts[id(p)]
539	            if swap or tf[pid][0] >= MIN_LINK_VOTES:
540	                parent[find(pid)] = find(id(q))
541	                linked.update((pid, id(q)))
542	        comps: dict = {}
543	        for r in d:
544	            if id(r) in linked:
545	                comps.setdefault(find(id(r)), []).append(r)
546	        for ci, members in enumerate(comps.values()):
547	            key = ("wrong_precinct", bid, ci)
548	            for r in members:
549	                if r.file and r.scan:
550	                    slots += [Slot(r, p, "wrong_precinct", key) for p in diff_parts(r)]
551	                else:
552	                    slots.append(Slot(r, "votes", "wrong_precinct", key))
553	        for r in d:
554	            if id(r) in linked:
555	                continue
556	            key = (None, bid, r.precinct)
557	            if r.file is None:
558	                slots.append(Slot(r, "votes", "missing_row", ("missing_row", *key[1:])))
559	            elif r.scan is None:
560	                slots.append(Slot(r, "votes", "extra_row", ("extra_row", *key[1:])))
561	            else:
562	                dp = diff_parts(r)
563	                cols = [p for p in dp if p != "votes"]
564	                if (len(cols) >= 2 and "votes" not in dp and
565	                        sorted(r.file[p] for p in cols) == sorted(r.scan[p] for p in cols)):
566	                    slots += [Slot(r, p, "wrong_column", ("wrong_column", *key[1:])) for p in cols]
567	                else:
568	                    slots += [Slot(r, p, "wrong_number", ("wrong_number", *key[1:])) for p in dp]
569	    for r in rows:                                    # the file's own sum, whatever the scan says
570	        if row_fails_own_total(r):
571	            slots = [s for s in slots if not (s.row is r and s.part == "votes")]
572	            slots.append(Slot(r, "votes", "file_row_fails_own_total",
573	                              ("file_row_fails_own_total", r.block.id if r.block else None, r.precinct, r.file_idx)))
574	    return slots

589	def reread_slots(slots, geo, gw, crop_dir: Path, *, log=print) -> dict:
590	    """Look at each disagreeing value on the scan once more: 400 dpi crop, claude-sonnet-4.6, up to three at a time.
591	    Returns {entity: {value, model, dpi, crop, error}}."""
592	    todo: dict = {}
593	    for s in slots:
594	        if s.row.file and s.row.scan and s.part in diff_parts(s.row):
595	            ent = entity_key(s.row, s.part)
596	            if ent is not None:
597	                todo.setdefault(ent, None)
598	    jobs, out = [], {}
599	    for n, ent in enumerate(todo, 1):
600	        t = target_for(ent)
601	        try:
602	            path, _ = geo.crop(ent[1], ent[2], t, REREAD_DPI, crop_dir / f"audit-reread-{n:04d}-{ent[2]}.png")
603	        except Exception as e:                        # no crop for it: the re-read cannot be made
604	            out[ent] = {"value": None, "model": REREAD_MODEL, "dpi": REREAD_DPI, "crop": None,
605	                        "error": f"no crop: {str(e)[:120]}"}
606	            continue
607	        jobs.append((ent, t, path))
608	    stop = threading.Event()
609	
610	    def run(job):
611	        ent, t, path = job
612	        if stop.is_set():
613	            return ent, {"value": None, "model": REREAD_MODEL, "dpi": REREAD_DPI, "crop": str(path),
614	                         "error": "not made: the run's budget was reached"}
615	        try:
616	            v = _reread_one(gw, path, t, REREAD_MODEL)
617	            return ent, {"value": v, "model": REREAD_MODEL, "dpi": REREAD_DPI, "crop": str(path), "error": None}
618	        except BudgetExceeded as e:
619	            stop.set()
620	            return ent, {"value": None, "model": REREAD_MODEL, "dpi": REREAD_DPI, "crop": str(path), "error": str(e)[:120]}
621	        except Exception as e:
622	            return ent, {"value": None, "model": REREAD_MODEL, "dpi": REREAD_DPI, "crop": str(path),
623	                         "error": f"no usable answer: {str(e)[:120]}"}
624	    with ThreadPoolExecutor(PARALLEL) as ex:
625	        for ent, res in ex.map(run, jobs):
626	            out[ent] = res
627	    log(f"  re-read {len(jobs)} values on the scan")
628	    return out

645	def audit_county(county, led, geo, gw, file_rows, *, run_dir, make_crops=True, log=print, data_root=None,
646	                 file_name=None, policy=None, run_id="") -> dict:
647	    """Run the audit on a closed ledger. Re-reads go through `gw`; the ledger is changed only where a re-read gave the
648	    file's value and every sum holds with it. Returns the findings, groups, corrections and what could not be matched."""
649	    t0 = time.time()
650	    run_dir = Path(run_dir)
651	    crop_dir = run_dir / county / "crops"              # one picture per group
652	    reread_dir = run_dir / "crops"                     # the re-read crops, not committed
653	    cells, totals, blocks, fcs = _state(led, county, file_rows, gw, log)
654	    matching = match(blocks, fcs, gw, log)
655	    rows = build_rows(blocks, matching, fcs, file_rows)
656	    slots = classify(rows)
657	    n0 = len(slots)
658	    log(f"  {len(rows)} rows compared; {n0} disagreements to look at on the scan")
659	    reads = reread_slots(slots, geo, gw, reread_dir, log=log) if slots else {}
660	    # a re-read that gives the file's value, with every sum holding with it, shows the ledger was wrong
661	    corrected_events, agreed_ledger = [], 0
662	    where = {entity_key(s.row, s.part): (s.row, s.part) for s in slots}
663	    for ent, rd in reads.items():
664	        if rd["value"] is None:
665	            continue
666	        row, part = where[ent]
667	        fv, old = row.file[part], row.scan[part]
668	        if rd["value"] == old:
669	            agreed_ledger += 1
670	        elif rd["value"] == fv:
671	            cs, ts = _block_rows(cells, totals, ent[1], ent[2])
672	            sums = sums_for(ent, old, fv, cs, ts)
673	            if sums and all(x["holds_with_file"] for x in sums):
674	                if ent[0] == "cell":
675	                    led.set_value(county, ent[1], ent[2], ent[3], ent[4], fv, REREAD_MODEL)
676	                    led.set_status(county, ent[1], ent[2], ent[3], ent[4], "first_read")
677	                else:
678	                    led.put_total(county, ent[1], ent[2], ent[3], ent[4], fv)
679	                led.event(county, "audit_ledger_corrected", {"entity": list(ent), "old": old, "new": fv,
680	                                                             "model": REREAD_MODEL, "dpi": REREAD_DPI, "sums": sums})
681	                corrected_events.append({"entity": list(ent), "old": old, "new": fv, "sums": sums})
682	                cells, totals = led.cells(county), led.totals(county)
683	    if corrected_events:
684	        agent.derive_status(led, county)
685	        cells, totals, blocks, fcs = _state(led, county, file_rows, gw, log)
686	        rows = build_rows(blocks, matching, fcs, file_rows)
687	        slots = classify(rows)
688	    findings, groups = _findings(county, slots, reads, cells, totals, geo, file_rows)
689	    res = {"findings": findings, "groups": groups, "matching": matching, "rows": len(rows), "crop_dir": crop_dir,
690	           "corrected_events": corrected_events, "reads": reads,
691	           "audit": {"disagreements_found": n0, "rereads": len(reads), "rereads_agreed_with_ledger": agreed_ledger,
692	                     "rereads_agreed_with_file": sum(1 for r in reads.values() if r["value"] is not None) - agreed_ledger -
693	                     sum(1 for ent, r in reads.items() if r["value"] is not None and r["value"] != where[ent][0].file[where[ent][1]]
694	                         and r["value"] != where[ent][0].scan[where[ent][1]]),
695	                     "ledger_corrected": len(corrected_events), "seconds": round(time.time() - t0, 1)}}
696	    res["file_name"] = file_name
697	    return res

700	def _findings(county, slots, reads, cells, totals, geo, file_rows):
701	    order = {}
702	    for s in slots:
703	        order.setdefault(s.group, len(order))
704	    gnames = {g: f"g{n + 1:03d}" for g, n in order.items()}
705	    slots = sorted(slots, key=lambda s: (order[s.group], PARTS.index(s.part)))
706	    findings, counter = [], 0
707	    for s in slots:
708	        r = s.row
709	        ent = entity_key(r, s.part)
710	        sv = r.scan[s.part] if r.scan else None
711	        fv = r.file[s.part] if r.file else None
712	        page, bid = (r.block.page, r.block.id) if r.block else (None, None)
713	        sums = []
714	        if ent is not None and (fv is not None or sv is not None):
715	            cs, ts = _block_rows(cells, totals, page, bid)
716	            sums = sums_for(ent, sv, fv, cs, ts)
717	        rd = reads.get(ent) if ent else None
718	        doubt = None
719	        if rd is not None:
720	            if rd["value"] is None:
721	                doubt = f"the re-read of the scan could not be made ({rd['error']})"
722	            elif rd["value"] == fv and fv != sv:
723	                doubt = (f"the re-read of the scan gave the file's value {fv}, but the sums do not all hold with it, so "
724	                         "the scan's value is in doubt")
725	            elif rd["value"] != sv:
726	                doubt = f"the re-read of the scan gave {rd['value']}, a third value (the ledger has {sv}, the file {fv})"
727	        if ent is None:
728	            status, why = "cannot_verify", "this file row has no matching contest on the scan, so no printed total covers it"
729	        else:
730	            status, why = decide_status(sums, doubt)
731	        if s.kind == "file_row_fails_own_total":
732	            f = r.file
733	            own = f"the file's votes {f['votes']} differ from its parts {f['absentee']} + {f['early_voting']} + " \
734	                  f"{f['election_day']} = {f['absentee'] + f['early_voting'] + f['election_day']}; "
735	            why = own + why
736	        counter += 1
737	        box = None
738	        if ent is not None and ent[0] == "cell" and r.scan:
739	            c = next((c for c in cells if checks.cell_key(c) == tuple(ent[1:])), None)
740	            box = [c[k] for k in ("x0", "y0", "x1", "y1")] if c and c["x0"] is not None else None
741	        elif ent is not None and ent[0] == "total":
742	            tb = geo.total_box(page, bid, "col", r.precinct) if hasattr(geo, "total_box") else None
743	            box = list(tb) if tb else None
744	        if box is None and ent is not None and r.block is not None:
745	            try:
746	                cb = geo.cell_box(page, bid, SCAN_ROW.get(s.part, "EARLY") if s.part != "votes" else "EARLY", r.precinct)
747	                box = list(cb) if cb else None
748	            except Exception:

776	def _spans(line: str) -> list[tuple[int, int]]:
777	    """Character spans of the fields of one csv line (quotes respected), without the line ending."""
778	    spans, start, i, q = [], 0, 0, False
779	    body = line.rstrip("\r\n")
780	    while i < len(body):
781	        ch = body[i]
782	        if ch == '"':
783	            q = not q
784	        elif ch == "," and not q:
785	            spans.append((start, i))
786	            start = i + 1
787	        i += 1
788	    spans.append((start, len(body)))
789	    return spans

792	def apply_corrections(raw: bytes, findings: list[dict]) -> tuple[bytes, str, list[dict]]:
793	    """Change only the cells whose finding is settled_against_file (and whose scan value is a number and whose file row
794	    exists); keep every other byte. Returns (new bytes, unified diff of exactly the changed lines, what was applied).
795	    Each finding needs {file_row, part, file_value, scan_value, kind, status}; file_row is the index among the data rows."""
796	    text = raw.decode("utf-8")
797	    lines = text.splitlines(True)
798	    header = next(csv.reader(io.StringIO(lines[0])))
799	    new, applied = list(lines), []
800	    for f in findings:
801	        if (f.get("status") != "settled_against_file" or f.get("kind") not in CORRECTABLE or f.get("file_row") is None
802	                or not isinstance(f.get("scan_value"), int) or f["part"] not in header):
803	            continue
804	        i = f["file_row"] + 1
805	        if i >= len(new):
806	            continue
807	        sp = _spans(new[i])
808	        a, b = sp[header.index(f["part"])]
809	        new[i] = new[i][:a] + str(f["scan_value"]) + new[i][b:]
810	        applied.append({"finding": f.get("id"), "file_row": f["file_row"], "part": f["part"],
811	                        "old": f.get("file_value"), "new": f["scan_value"]})
812	    out = "".join(new)
813	    name = "published file"
814	    diff = "".join(difflib.unified_diff(lines, new, fromfile=f"a/{name}", tofile=f"b/{name}", n=0))
815	    return out.encode("utf-8"), diff, applied

852	            m["calls"] += 1
