"""The audit: compare a closed ledger with the published file, settle each disagreement with the scan's printed totals.

The published file is a second reading of the same scan. It tells the audit where to look, never what to write: a
value changes only because a re-read of the scan gave it, and a correction to the file is written only where a printed
total decides it.

Steps: (1) match the scan's contests and candidates to the file's, by normalised labels first, then once per county
by the model as two lists (checked in code: one-to-one, close county totals); what is left is listed. (2) Compare every
part of every row. (3) Look at each disagreeing value on the scan once more (400 dpi, claude-sonnet-4.6, up to three at
a time); if it gives the file's value and the sums hold with it, the ledger was wrong, it is corrected, and there is no
finding. (4) Classify what is left, group the findings that describe one slip, and decide each one's status from the
sums it sits on. (5) Write the corrected file, which differs from the published one only where a finding is
`settled_against_file`.

findings.json
  county, run_id, file         names; file = the published file's name
  policy                       {question_id, answer, answered_by, meaning}
  counts                       {findings, by_kind, by_status, groups, corrections}
  findings  [{id, group, county, office, district, party, candidate, precinct,
              part                  votes | absentee | early_voting | election_day
              file_value, scan_value   integers, or null (a row the file lacks, or the scan lacks)
              kind                  file_row_fails_own_total | wrong_number | wrong_column | wrong_precinct |
                                    missing_row | extra_row
              status                settled_against_file | document_inconsistent | cannot_verify
              reason                the status in words
              sums  [{name, kind, terms [{cell, value}], printed, printed_label, computed_with_scan, holds_with_scan,
                      computed_with_file, holds_with_file}]   the printed totals that decide it
              page, block, box      where the scan's cell is ([x0, y0, x1, y1] at 200 dpi), or null
              crop                  path of the group's picture, relative to the county folder
              reread                {model, dpi, value, crop} or null: the single-value re-read of the scan
              file_row, file_line   index among the file's data rows, and its line number in the file, or null
              corrected             true when the corrected file differs from the published one at this value
              confirmed_by_person   false until a person changes it}]
  groups    [{id, kind, office, district, candidate, precincts, page, block, findings [ids], statuses, crop}]
  corrections  [{finding, file_row, part, old, new}]
  unmatched    {scan: [...], file: [...], rejected: [...], model: {...}}    what could not be matched, and why
  corrected_events [...]           ledger values the re-read changed (the file was right), each with its sums
  audit        {rereads, rereads_agreed_with_ledger, rereads_agreed_with_file, ledger_corrected, seconds}
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import csv
import difflib
import io
import json
import re
import threading
import time
from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor
from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from pathlib import Path

from . import agent, checks
from .model import BudgetExceeded, Gateway, price
from .sources import _int

PARTS = ("votes", "absentee", "early_voting", "election_day")
SCAN_ROW = {"absentee": "ABSENTEE", "early_voting": "EARLY", "election_day": "PRECINCT"}
KINDS = ("file_row_fails_own_total", "wrong_number", "wrong_column", "wrong_precinct", "missing_row", "extra_row")
STATUSES = ("settled_against_file", "document_inconsistent", "cannot_verify")
REREAD_MODEL = agent.SONNET
REREAD_DPI = 400
PARALLEL = 3
CLOSE_ENOUGH = 0.10        # mapped pairs: county totals within this share of each other
MIN_LINK_VOTES = 10        # a row moved to another precinct is recognised by its values; small ones coincide too easily,
                           # so below this many votes only a swap (each row sits where the other belongs) counts
CORRECTABLE = ("wrong_number", "wrong_column", "wrong_precinct", "file_row_fails_own_total")


# ---- labels ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

def nk(s) -> str:
    return re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]", "", str(s or "").lower())


_PARTY = re.compile(r"\s*[\(\[]\s*(?:[A-Za-z]{2,4}|write[\s-]*in)\s*[\)\]]\s*$", re.I)
_WORDS = re.compile(r"\b(?:district|precinct no\.?|precinct)\b", re.I)


def candidate_key(label) -> str:
    """A candidate's label as the scan prints it ("A/B (PARTY)", "Name [REP]") or the file has it, normalised."""
    return nk(_PARTY.sub("", str(label or "")).split("/")[0])


def contest_keys(label) -> list[str]:
    a, b = nk(label), nk(_WORDS.sub("", str(label or "")))
    return [a] if a == b else [a, b]


# ---- the scan, as blocks -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

@dataclass
class Block:
    id: str
    page: int
    contest: str            # as printed, with "Write In" replaced by the contest above it
    candidate: str | None
    cells: dict = field(default_factory=dict)      # (row_kind, column) -> cell dict
    totals: dict = field(default_factory=dict)     # (direction, key) -> value
    cols: list = field(default_factory=list)

    def total(self) -> int | None:
        g = self.totals.get(("grand", ""))
        if g is not None:
            return g
        cs = [v for (d, _), v in self.totals.items() if d == "col"]
        return sum(cs) if cs else None


def scan_blocks(cells, totals) -> list[Block]:
    out, by, cur = [], {}, None
    for c in cells:
        k = (c["page"], c["block_id"])
        if k not in by:
            label = c["contest"] or ""
            if nk(label) == "writein":
                label = cur or label
            else:
                cur = label
            by[k] = Block(c["block_id"], c["page"], label, c["candidate"])
            out.append(by[k])
        b = by[k]
        if c["value"] is not None:
            b.cells[(c["row_kind"], c["column"])] = c
        if c["column"] not in b.cols:
            b.cols.append(c["column"])
    for t in totals:
        b = by.get((t["page"], t["block_id"]))
        if b is not None:
            b.totals[(t["direction"], t["key"])] = t["value"]
    return out


# ---- the file, as contests and candidates ------------------------------------------------------------------------

@dataclass
class FileCand:
    key: str
    label: str
    rows: dict = field(default_factory=dict)       # precinct -> (index, row)


@dataclass
class FileContest:
    key: str
    label: str
    district: str
    cands: dict = field(default_factory=dict)      # candidate key -> FileCand


def file_contests(rows: list[dict]) -> dict:
    out: dict = {}
    for i, r in enumerate(rows):
        k = nk((r.get("office") or "") + " " + (r.get("district") or ""))
        fc = out.setdefault(k, FileContest(k, r.get("office") or "", r.get("district") or ""))
        ck = candidate_key(r.get("candidate"))
        cand = fc.cands.setdefault(ck, FileCand(ck, r.get("candidate") or ""))
        cand.rows.setdefault(str(r.get("precinct")), (i, r))
    return out


def file_votes(cand: FileCand) -> int:
    return sum(_int(r.get("votes")) or 0 for _, r in cand.rows.values())


# ---- matching ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

MATCH_PROMPT = """Two lists of election contests and candidates describe the same election. One list is read from a
scanned canvass, the other from a published spreadsheet. Spelling and wording differ ("United States Senator" and
"U.S. Senate" are the same contest). Pair only the entries that are certainly the same; leave out any you are not sure of.
{lists}
Answer with strict JSON only: {{"contests": [[scan number, file number], ...], "candidates": [[scan number, file number], ...]}}.
Each number may appear at most once."""


def match_validator(ns):
    def check(d):
        if not isinstance(d, dict):
            raise ValueError("answer must be an object")
        for name, (a, b) in ns.items():
            pairs = d.get(name)
            if not isinstance(pairs, list):
                raise ValueError(f'"{name}" must be a list of pairs')
            for p in pairs:
                if not (isinstance(p, list) and len(p) == 2 and all(isinstance(x, int) and not isinstance(x, bool)
                                                                     for x in p)):
                    raise ValueError(f'"{name}" holds pairs of whole numbers')
    return check


def _close(a, b) -> bool:
    if a is None or b is None:
        return False
    return abs(a - b) <= CLOSE_ENOUGH * max(a, b, 1)


@dataclass
class Matching:
    block_map: dict = field(default_factory=dict)       # block id -> (file contest key, file candidate key)
    unmatched_scan: list = field(default_factory=list)
    unmatched_file: list = field(default_factory=list)
    rejected: list = field(default_factory=list)
    model: dict = field(default_factory=dict)


def match(blocks: list[Block], fcs: dict, gw=None, log=print) -> Matching:
    """Scan block -> file candidate. Normalised labels first; what is left goes to the model once, as two lists."""
    m = Matching()
    fkeys = set(fcs)
    cmap: dict = {}                                   # scan contest label -> file contest key
    for label in dict.fromkeys(b.contest for b in blocks):
        k = next((k for k in contest_keys(label) if k in fkeys), None)
        if k is not None and k not in cmap.values():
            cmap[label] = k

    def by_names(bs, label_map):
        used = set()
        for b in bs:
            fk = label_map.get(b.contest)
            ck = candidate_key(b.candidate)
            if fk is not None and ck in fcs[fk].cands and (fk, ck) not in used and b.id not in m.block_map:
                m.block_map[b.id] = (fk, ck)
                used.add((fk, ck))
        used.update(m.block_map.values())
        return used

    by_names(blocks, cmap)

    def leftovers():
        used = set(m.block_map.values())
        sc = [b for b in blocks if b.id not in m.block_map]
        fc = [(fk, ck) for fk, c in fcs.items() for ck in c.cands if (fk, ck) not in used]
        return sc, fc

    sc, fc = leftovers()
    s_con = [l for l in dict.fromkeys(b.contest for b in sc) if l not in cmap]
    f_con = [fcs[k] for k in fcs if k not in cmap.values() and any((k, ck) in set(fc) for ck in fcs[k].cands)]
    if gw is not None and sc and fc:
        s_can = sc
        f_can = fc
        lists = ("SCAN CONTESTS:\n" + "\n".join(f"{i}: {l}" for i, l in enumerate(s_con)) +
                 "\nFILE CONTESTS:\n" + "\n".join(f"{j}: {c.label}{' district ' + c.district if c.district else ''}"
                                                   for j, c in enumerate(f_con)) +
                 "\nSCAN CANDIDATES:\n" + "\n".join(f"{i}: {b.contest} :: {b.candidate}" for i, b in enumerate(s_can)) +
                 "\nFILE CANDIDATES:\n" + "\n".join(
                     f"{j}: {fcs[fk].label}{' district ' + fcs[fk].district if fcs[fk].district else ''} :: "
                     f"{fcs[fk].cands[ck].label}" for j, (fk, ck) in enumerate(f_can)))
        ns = {"contests": (len(s_con), len(f_con)), "candidates": (len(s_can), len(f_can))}
        try:
            ans = gw.ask_json(MATCH_PROMPT.format(lists=lists), validate=match_validator(ns), model=agent.SONNET)
        except BudgetExceeded:
            raise
        except ValueError as e:
            ans = {"contests": [], "candidates": []}
            m.rejected.append({"what": "the model's answer", "why": f"not usable: {str(e)[:150]}"})
        m.model = {"asked": {"scan_contests": s_con, "file_contests": [c.label for c in f_con],
                             "scan_candidates": [f"{b.contest} :: {b.candidate}" for b in s_can],
                             "file_candidates": [f"{fcs[fk].label} :: {fcs[fk].cands[ck].label}" for fk, ck in f_can]},
                   "answer": ans}
        # contests: one-to-one, and the blocks of the scan contest add up close to the file's rows
        seen_s, seen_f = set(), set()
        for i, j in ans.get("contests", []):
            if not (0 <= i < len(s_con) and 0 <= j < len(f_con)) or i in seen_s or j in seen_f:
                m.rejected.append({"what": f"contest pair {i}/{j}", "why": "not one-to-one, or not in the list"})
                continue
            seen_s.add(i); seen_f.add(j)
            sa = sum(b.total() or 0 for b in blocks if b.contest == s_con[i])
            fb = sum(file_votes(c) for c in f_con[j].cands.values())
            if not _close(sa, fb):
                m.rejected.append({"what": f"{s_con[i]} = {f_con[j].label}",
                                   "why": f"county totals are not close (scan {sa}, file {fb})"})
                continue
            cmap[s_con[i]] = f_con[j].key
        by_names(blocks, cmap)
        sc, fc = leftovers()
        fset = set(fc)
        seen_s, seen_f = set(), set()
        for i, j in ans.get("candidates", []):
            if not (0 <= i < len(s_can) and 0 <= j < len(f_can)) or i in seen_s or j in seen_f:
                m.rejected.append({"what": f"candidate pair {i}/{j}", "why": "not one-to-one, or not in the list"})
                continue
            seen_s.add(i); seen_f.add(j)
            b, (fk, ck) = s_can[i], f_can[j]
            if b.id in m.block_map or (fk, ck) not in fset:
                continue                                  # already matched by name inside a mapped contest
            if cmap.get(b.contest) != fk:
                m.rejected.append({"what": f"{b.candidate} = {fcs[fk].cands[ck].label}",
                                   "why": "their contests are not paired"})
                continue
            if not _close(b.total(), file_votes(fcs[fk].cands[ck])):
                m.rejected.append({"what": f"{b.candidate} = {fcs[fk].cands[ck].label}",
                                   "why": f"county totals are not close (scan {b.total()}, "
                                          f"file {file_votes(fcs[fk].cands[ck])})"})
                continue
            m.block_map[b.id] = (fk, ck)
    sc, fc = leftovers()
    m.unmatched_scan = [{"block": b.id, "page": b.page, "contest": b.contest, "candidate": b.candidate} for b in sc]
    m.unmatched_file = [{"contest": fcs[fk].label, "district": fcs[fk].district, "candidate": fcs[fk].cands[ck].label,
                         "rows": len(fcs[fk].cands[ck].rows)} for fk, ck in fc]
    return m


# ---- rows --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

@dataclass
class Row:
    block: Block | None
    precinct: str
    file: dict | None             # part -> int | None
    file_idx: int | None
    file_row: dict | None
    scan: dict | None             # part -> int | None
    office: str = ""
    district: str = ""
    party: str = ""
    candidate: str = ""

    @property
    def page(self):
        return self.block.page if self.block else None


def _file_parts(r: dict) -> dict:
    return {p: _int(r.get(p)) for p in PARTS}


def _scan_parts(b: Block, col: str) -> dict | None:
    if b.id == "reg":
        c = b.cells.get(("REGISTERED", col))
        return {"votes": c["value"], "absentee": None, "early_voting": None, "election_day": None} if c else None
    got = {p: (b.cells[(SCAN_ROW[p], col)]["value"] if (SCAN_ROW[p], col) in b.cells else None)
           for p in PARTS if p != "votes"}
    if all(v is None for v in got.values()):
        return None
    return {"votes": b.totals.get(("col", col)), **got}


def build_rows(blocks, matching, fcs, file_rows) -> list[Row]:
    out, seen = [], set()
    for b in blocks:
        if b.id not in matching.block_map:
            continue
        fk, ck = matching.block_map[b.id]
        fc, cand = fcs[fk], fcs[fk].cands[ck]
        order = list(b.cols) + [p for p in cand.rows if p not in b.cols]
        for p in order:
            sp = _scan_parts(b, p) if p in b.cols else None
            fr = cand.rows.get(p)
            if sp is None and fr is None:
                continue
            if fr:
                seen.add(fr[0])
            r = fr[1] if fr else {}
            out.append(Row(b, p, _file_parts(r) if fr else None, fr[0] if fr else None, r or None, sp,
                           fc.label, fc.district, (r.get("party") if fr else "") or "", cand.label))
    for i, r in enumerate(file_rows):      # file rows with no scan block: only their own sum can be tested
        if i not in seen:
            out.append(Row(None, str(r.get("precinct")), _file_parts(r), i, r, None, r.get("office") or "",
                           r.get("district") or "", r.get("party") or "", r.get("candidate") or ""))
    return out


def row_fails_own_total(r: Row) -> bool:
    f = r.file
    if not f or any(f[p] is None for p in PARTS):
        return False
    return f["votes"] != f["absentee"] + f["early_voting"] + f["election_day"]


def diff_parts(r: Row) -> list[str]:
    if not r.file or not r.scan:
        return []
    return [p for p in PARTS if r.file[p] is not None and r.scan[p] is not None and r.file[p] != r.scan[p]]


# ---- the sums that decide ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

def decide_status(sums: list[dict], doubt: str | None = None) -> tuple[str, str]:
    """The status of a disagreement from the printed sums it sits on. Each sum: {name, holds_with_scan, holds_with_file}.

    settled_against_file: at least one printed total holds with the scan's value and fails with the file's, and none holds
      with the file's and fails with the scan's, and the scan's totals do not disagree with each other at the cell.
    document_inconsistent: the scan's own printed totals disagree with each other at the cell: some hold with the
      scan's value and some do not (the reason names which).
    cannot_verify: no printed total decides (a sum that fails with both values decides nothing), or the scan's value
      is itself in doubt."""
    if doubt:
        return "cannot_verify", doubt
    for_scan = [s for s in sums if s["holds_with_scan"] and not s["holds_with_file"]]
    for_file = [s for s in sums if not s["holds_with_scan"] and s["holds_with_file"]]
    both_fail = [s for s in sums if not s["holds_with_scan"] and not s["holds_with_file"]]
    if for_scan and for_file:
        return ("document_inconsistent",
                "the scan's own printed totals disagree with each other at this cell: " +
                "; ".join(s["name"] for s in for_scan) + " hold(s) with the scan's value and fail(s) with the file's, but " +
                "; ".join(s["name"] for s in for_file) + " hold(s) with the file's value and fail(s) with the scan's")
    if for_scan:
        note = (" (" + "; ".join(s["name"] for s in both_fail) + " fail with either value and decide nothing)"
                if both_fail else "")
        return ("settled_against_file",
                "; ".join(s["name"] for s in for_scan) + " hold(s) with the scan's value and fail(s) with the file's, "
                "and no printed total holds with the file's value and fails with the scan's" + note)
    if for_file:
        return ("cannot_verify",
                "the scan's value is in doubt: " + "; ".join(s["name"] for s in for_file) +
                " holds with the file's value and fails with the scan's, and no printed total supports the scan's")
    return "cannot_verify", ("no printed total decides: " + ("; ".join(s["name"] for s in sums) +
                                                              " give the same answer with either value"
                                                              if sums else "no printed total covers this value"))


def describe_sum(ch) -> tuple[str, str]:
    """(name, label of the printed total) of a check, in words."""
    if ch.kind == "row":
        if ch.key == "REGISTERED":
            return ("the registered-voters row (its cells add to the printed total of the row; this row has no other sum)",
                    "printed total at the right end of the row")
        return (f"the {ch.key} cells across the page add to the row total printed at the right end of the row",
                "printed total at the right end of the row")
    if ch.kind == "col":
        return (f"the three cells of precinct {ch.key} add to the small total printed under the column",
                "small total printed under the column")
    if ch.kind == "grand_col":
        return "the small totals under the columns add to the grand total", "grand total"
    return "the row totals add to the grand total", "grand total"


def entity_key(row: Row, part: str) -> tuple | None:
    """The scan value a part of a row is: ('cell', page, block, row_kind, column) or ('total', page, block, 'col', column)."""
    b = row.block
    if b is None:
        return None
    if part == "votes":
        return ("cell", b.page, b.id, "REGISTERED", row.precinct) if b.id == "reg" else \
            ("total", b.page, b.id, "col", row.precinct)
    return ("cell", b.page, b.id, SCAN_ROW[part], row.precinct)


def _variant(cells, totals, ent, value):
    cs, ts = [dict(c) for c in cells], [dict(t) for t in totals]
    if ent[0] == "cell":
        key = tuple(ent[1:])
        hit = [c for c in cs if checks.cell_key(c) == key]
        for c in hit:
            c["value"] = value
        if not hit and value is not None:
            cs.append({"page": ent[1], "block_id": ent[2], "row_kind": ent[3], "column": ent[4], "value": value})
    else:
        key = tuple(ent[1:])
        hit = [t for t in ts if (t["page"], t["block_id"], t["direction"], t["key"]) == key]
        for t in hit:
            t["value"] = value
        if not hit and value is not None:
            ts.append({"page": ent[1], "block_id": ent[2], "direction": ent[3], "key": ent[4], "value": value})
    return checks.all_checks(cs, ts)


def _ck(c):
    return (c.kind, c.page, c.block_id, c.key)


def _touches(ch, ent) -> bool:
    key = tuple(ent[1:])
    if ent[0] == "cell":
        return any(k == key for k, _ in ch.terms)
    return ch.printed_key == key or any(k == key for k, _ in ch.terms)


def sums_for(ent, scan_value, file_value, cells, totals) -> list[dict]:
    """The printed sums the scan value sits on, each tested with the scan's value and with the file's (a value the file
    lacks counts as 0; one the scan lacks counts as absent). `cells`/`totals` are the ledger's rows of the one block."""
    with_scan = {_ck(c): c for c in _variant(cells, totals, ent, scan_value)}
    with_file = {_ck(c): c for c in _variant(cells, totals, ent, 0 if file_value is None else file_value)}
    out = []
    for k, fch in with_file.items():
        sch = with_scan.get(k)
        if sch is None or not (_touches(fch, ent) or _touches(sch, ent)):
            continue
        name, label = describe_sum(sch)
        out.append({"name": name, "kind": sch.kind, "page": sch.page, "block": sch.block_id,
                    "terms": [{"cell": list(kk), "value": v} for kk, v in sch.terms], "printed": sch.printed,
                    "printed_label": label, "computed_with_scan": sch.computed, "holds_with_scan": sch.ok,
                    "computed_with_file": fch.computed, "holds_with_file": fch.ok})
    order = {"row": 0, "col": 1, "grand_col": 2, "grand_row": 3}
    out.sort(key=lambda s: order[s["kind"]])
    return out


# ---- classification and groups -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------

@dataclass
class Slot:
    row: Row
    part: str
    kind: str
    group: tuple


def _tuple(d):
    return tuple(d[p] for p in PARTS) if d and all(d[p] is not None for p in PARTS) else None


def classify(rows: list[Row]) -> list[Slot]:
    """Every disagreement as a slot with a kind and a group key. A group is one slip:
    wrong_precinct  the same row of values sits under another precinct of the same candidate (unique matches only)
    wrong_column    the same values sit in other parts of the same precinct
    wrong_number    anything else that differs
    missing_row / extra_row    the scan has a row the file lacks, or the other way round
    file_row_fails_own_total   the file's votes differ from its three parts (whether or not the scan differs)"""
    slots: list[Slot] = []
    by_block: dict = {}
    for r in rows:
        by_block.setdefault(r.block.id if r.block else None, []).append(r)
    for bid, rs in by_block.items():
        if bid is None:
            continue
        d = [r for r in rs if (r.file is None) != (r.scan is None) or diff_parts(r)]
        tf = {id(r): _tuple(r.file) for r in d}
        ts = {id(r): _tuple(r.scan) for r in d}
        parent = {id(r): id(r) for r in d}

        def find(x):
            while parent[x] != x:
                parent[x] = parent[parent[x]]
                x = parent[x]
            return x
        linked, edge = set(), {}
        for p in d:
            v = tf[id(p)]
            if v is None or not any(v):
                continue
            src = [x for x in d if tf[id(x)] == v]
            dst = [x for x in d if ts[id(x)] == v and x is not p]
            if len(src) == 1 and len(dst) == 1:
                edge[id(p)] = dst[0]
        for pid, q in edge.items():
            p = next(x for x in d if id(x) == pid)
            swap = tf[id(q)] is not None and tf[id(q)] == ts[id(p)]
            if swap or tf[pid][0] >= MIN_LINK_VOTES:
                parent[find(pid)] = find(id(q))
                linked.update((pid, id(q)))
        comps: dict = {}
        for r in d:
            if id(r) in linked:
                comps.setdefault(find(id(r)), []).append(r)
        for ci, members in enumerate(comps.values()):
            key = ("wrong_precinct", bid, ci)
            for r in members:
                if r.file and r.scan:
                    slots += [Slot(r, p, "wrong_precinct", key) for p in diff_parts(r)]
                else:
                    slots.append(Slot(r, "votes", "wrong_precinct", key))
        for r in d:
            if id(r) in linked:
                continue
            key = (None, bid, r.precinct)
            if r.file is None:
                slots.append(Slot(r, "votes", "missing_row", ("missing_row", *key[1:])))
            elif r.scan is None:
                slots.append(Slot(r, "votes", "extra_row", ("extra_row", *key[1:])))
            else:
                dp = diff_parts(r)
                cols = [p for p in dp if p != "votes"]
                if (len(cols) >= 2 and "votes" not in dp and
                        sorted(r.file[p] for p in cols) == sorted(r.scan[p] for p in cols)):
                    slots += [Slot(r, p, "wrong_column", ("wrong_column", *key[1:])) for p in cols]
                else:
                    slots += [Slot(r, p, "wrong_number", ("wrong_number", *key[1:])) for p in dp]
    for r in rows:                                    # the file's own sum, whatever the scan says
        if row_fails_own_total(r):
            slots = [s for s in slots if not (s.row is r and s.part == "votes")]
            slots.append(Slot(r, "votes", "file_row_fails_own_total",
                              ("file_row_fails_own_total", r.block.id if r.block else None, r.precinct, r.file_idx)))
    return slots


# ---- re-reads ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

def target_for(ent) -> dict:
    return {"kind": "cell", "row": ent[3], "column": ent[4]} if ent[0] == "cell" else \
        {"kind": "col_total", "column": ent[4]}


def _reread_one(gw, path, t, model):
    prompt = agent.READ_PROMPTS[t["kind"]].format(row=t.get("row"), column=t.get("column"))
    return gw.ask_json(prompt, path, validate=agent.read_validator(t["kind"]), model=model)["value"]


def reread_slots(slots, geo, gw, crop_dir: Path, *, log=print) -> dict:
    """Look at each disagreeing value on the scan once more: 400 dpi crop, claude-sonnet-4.6, up to three at a time.
    Returns {entity: {value, model, dpi, crop, error}}."""
    todo: dict = {}
    for s in slots:
        if s.row.file and s.row.scan and s.part in diff_parts(s.row):
            ent = entity_key(s.row, s.part)
            if ent is not None:
                todo.setdefault(ent, None)
    jobs, out = [], {}
    for n, ent in enumerate(todo, 1):
        t = target_for(ent)
        try:
            path, _ = geo.crop(ent[1], ent[2], t, REREAD_DPI, crop_dir / f"audit-reread-{n:04d}-{ent[2]}.png")
        except Exception as e:                        # no crop for it: the re-read cannot be made
            out[ent] = {"value": None, "model": REREAD_MODEL, "dpi": REREAD_DPI, "crop": None,
                        "error": f"no crop: {str(e)[:120]}"}
            continue
        jobs.append((ent, t, path))
    stop = threading.Event()

    def run(job):
        ent, t, path = job
        if stop.is_set():
            return ent, {"value": None, "model": REREAD_MODEL, "dpi": REREAD_DPI, "crop": str(path),
                         "error": "not made: the run's budget was reached"}
        try:
            v = _reread_one(gw, path, t, REREAD_MODEL)
            return ent, {"value": v, "model": REREAD_MODEL, "dpi": REREAD_DPI, "crop": str(path), "error": None}
        except BudgetExceeded as e:
            stop.set()
            return ent, {"value": None, "model": REREAD_MODEL, "dpi": REREAD_DPI, "crop": str(path), "error": str(e)[:120]}
        except Exception as e:
            return ent, {"value": None, "model": REREAD_MODEL, "dpi": REREAD_DPI, "crop": str(path),
                         "error": f"no usable answer: {str(e)[:120]}"}
    with ThreadPoolExecutor(PARALLEL) as ex:
        for ent, res in ex.map(run, jobs):
            out[ent] = res
    log(f"  re-read {len(jobs)} values on the scan")
    return out


# ---- the audit ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

def _block_rows(cells, totals, page, bid):
    return ([c for c in cells if c["page"] == page and c["block_id"] == bid],
            [t for t in totals if t["page"] == page and t["block_id"] == bid])


def _state(led, county, file_rows, gw, log):
    cells, totals = led.cells(county), led.totals(county)
    blocks = scan_blocks(cells, totals)
    fcs = file_contests(file_rows)
    return cells, totals, blocks, fcs


def audit_county(county, led, geo, gw, file_rows, *, run_dir, make_crops=True, log=print, data_root=None,
                 file_name=None, policy=None, run_id="") -> dict:
    """Run the audit on a closed ledger. Re-reads go through `gw`; the ledger is changed only where a re-read gave the
    file's value and every sum holds with it. Returns the findings, groups, corrections and what could not be matched."""
    t0 = time.time()
    run_dir = Path(run_dir)
    crop_dir = run_dir / county / "crops"              # one picture per group
    reread_dir = run_dir / "crops"                     # the re-read crops, not committed
    cells, totals, blocks, fcs = _state(led, county, file_rows, gw, log)
    matching = match(blocks, fcs, gw, log)
    rows = build_rows(blocks, matching, fcs, file_rows)
    slots = classify(rows)
    n0 = len(slots)
    log(f"  {len(rows)} rows compared; {n0} disagreements to look at on the scan")
    reads = reread_slots(slots, geo, gw, reread_dir, log=log) if slots else {}
    # a re-read that gives the file's value, with every sum holding with it, shows the ledger was wrong
    corrected_events, agreed_ledger = [], 0
    where = {entity_key(s.row, s.part): (s.row, s.part) for s in slots}
    for ent, rd in reads.items():
        if rd["value"] is None:
            continue
        row, part = where[ent]
        fv, old = row.file[part], row.scan[part]
        if rd["value"] == old:
            agreed_ledger += 1
        elif rd["value"] == fv:
            cs, ts = _block_rows(cells, totals, ent[1], ent[2])
            sums = sums_for(ent, old, fv, cs, ts)
            if sums and all(x["holds_with_file"] for x in sums):
                if ent[0] == "cell":
                    led.set_value(county, ent[1], ent[2], ent[3], ent[4], fv, REREAD_MODEL)
                    led.set_status(county, ent[1], ent[2], ent[3], ent[4], "first_read")
                else:
                    led.put_total(county, ent[1], ent[2], ent[3], ent[4], fv)
                led.event(county, "audit_ledger_corrected", {"entity": list(ent), "old": old, "new": fv,
                                                             "model": REREAD_MODEL, "dpi": REREAD_DPI, "sums": sums})
                corrected_events.append({"entity": list(ent), "old": old, "new": fv, "sums": sums})
                cells, totals = led.cells(county), led.totals(county)
    if corrected_events:
        agent.derive_status(led, county)
        cells, totals, blocks, fcs = _state(led, county, file_rows, gw, log)
        rows = build_rows(blocks, matching, fcs, file_rows)
        slots = classify(rows)
    findings, groups = _findings(county, slots, reads, cells, totals, geo, file_rows)
    res = {"findings": findings, "groups": groups, "matching": matching, "rows": len(rows), "crop_dir": crop_dir,
           "corrected_events": corrected_events, "reads": reads,
           "audit": {"disagreements_found": n0, "rereads": len(reads), "rereads_agreed_with_ledger": agreed_ledger,
                     "rereads_agreed_with_file": sum(1 for r in reads.values() if r["value"] is not None) - agreed_ledger -
                     sum(1 for ent, r in reads.items() if r["value"] is not None and r["value"] != where[ent][0].file[where[ent][1]]
                         and r["value"] != where[ent][0].scan[where[ent][1]]),
                     "ledger_corrected": len(corrected_events), "seconds": round(time.time() - t0, 1)}}
    res["file_name"] = file_name
    return res


def _findings(county, slots, reads, cells, totals, geo, file_rows):
    order = {}
    for s in slots:
        order.setdefault(s.group, len(order))
    gnames = {g: f"g{n + 1:03d}" for g, n in order.items()}
    slots = sorted(slots, key=lambda s: (order[s.group], PARTS.index(s.part)))
    findings, counter = [], 0
    for s in slots:
        r = s.row
        ent = entity_key(r, s.part)
        sv = r.scan[s.part] if r.scan else None
        fv = r.file[s.part] if r.file else None
        page, bid = (r.block.page, r.block.id) if r.block else (None, None)
        sums = []
        if ent is not None and (fv is not None or sv is not None):
            cs, ts = _block_rows(cells, totals, page, bid)
            sums = sums_for(ent, sv, fv, cs, ts)
        rd = reads.get(ent) if ent else None
        doubt = None
        if rd is not None:
            if rd["value"] is None:
                doubt = f"the re-read of the scan could not be made ({rd['error']})"
            elif rd["value"] == fv and fv != sv:
                doubt = (f"the re-read of the scan gave the file's value {fv}, but the sums do not all hold with it, so "
                         "the scan's value is in doubt")
            elif rd["value"] != sv:
                doubt = f"the re-read of the scan gave {rd['value']}, a third value (the ledger has {sv}, the file {fv})"
        if ent is None:
            status, why = "cannot_verify", "this file row has no matching contest on the scan, so no printed total covers it"
        else:
            status, why = decide_status(sums, doubt)
        if s.kind == "file_row_fails_own_total":
            f = r.file
            own = f"the file's votes {f['votes']} differ from its parts {f['absentee']} + {f['early_voting']} + " \
                  f"{f['election_day']} = {f['absentee'] + f['early_voting'] + f['election_day']}; "
            why = own + why
        counter += 1
        box = None
        if ent is not None and ent[0] == "cell" and r.scan:
            c = next((c for c in cells if checks.cell_key(c) == tuple(ent[1:])), None)
            box = [c[k] for k in ("x0", "y0", "x1", "y1")] if c and c["x0"] is not None else None
        elif ent is not None and ent[0] == "total":
            tb = geo.total_box(page, bid, "col", r.precinct) if hasattr(geo, "total_box") else None
            box = list(tb) if tb else None
        if box is None and ent is not None and r.block is not None:
            try:
                cb = geo.cell_box(page, bid, SCAN_ROW.get(s.part, "EARLY") if s.part != "votes" else "EARLY", r.precinct)
                box = list(cb) if cb else None
            except Exception:
                box = None
        findings.append({
            "id": f"f{counter:03d}", "group": gnames[s.group], "county": county, "office": r.office,
            "district": r.district, "party": r.party, "candidate": r.candidate, "precinct": r.precinct,
            "part": s.part, "file_value": fv, "scan_value": sv, "kind": s.kind, "status": status, "reason": why,
            "sums": sums, "page": page, "block": bid, "box": box, "crop": None,
            "reread": ({k: rd[k] for k in ("model", "dpi", "value", "crop", "error")} if rd else None),
            "file_row": r.file_idx, "file_line": (r.file_idx + 2) if r.file_idx is not None else None,
            "corrected": False, "confirmed_by_person": False})
    groups = []
    for g, name in gnames.items():
        fs = [f for f in findings if f["group"] == name]
        f0 = fs[0]
        groups.append({"id": name, "kind": f0["kind"], "office": f0["office"], "district": f0["district"],
                       "candidate": f0["candidate"], "precincts": sorted({f["precinct"] for f in fs}, key=_pk),
                       "page": f0["page"], "block": f0["block"], "findings": [f["id"] for f in fs],
                       "statuses": {st: sum(1 for f in fs if f["status"] == st) for st in STATUSES
                                    if any(f["status"] == st for f in fs)}, "crop": None})
    return findings, groups


def _pk(p):
    return (0, int(p), "") if str(p).isdigit() else (1, 0, str(p))


# ---- the corrected file ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

def _spans(line: str) -> list[tuple[int, int]]:
    """Character spans of the fields of one csv line (quotes respected), without the line ending."""
    spans, start, i, q = [], 0, 0, False
    body = line.rstrip("\r\n")
    while i < len(body):
        ch = body[i]
        if ch == '"':
            q = not q
        elif ch == "," and not q:
            spans.append((start, i))
            start = i + 1
        i += 1
    spans.append((start, len(body)))
    return spans


def apply_corrections(raw: bytes, findings: list[dict]) -> tuple[bytes, str, list[dict]]:
    """Change only the cells whose finding is settled_against_file (and whose scan value is a number and whose file row
    exists); keep every other byte. Returns (new bytes, unified diff of exactly the changed lines, what was applied).
    Each finding needs {file_row, part, file_value, scan_value, kind, status}; file_row is the index among the data rows."""
    text = raw.decode("utf-8")
    lines = text.splitlines(True)
    header = next(csv.reader(io.StringIO(lines[0])))
    new, applied = list(lines), []
    for f in findings:
        if (f.get("status") != "settled_against_file" or f.get("kind") not in CORRECTABLE or f.get("file_row") is None
                or not isinstance(f.get("scan_value"), int) or f["part"] not in header):
            continue
        i = f["file_row"] + 1
        if i >= len(new):
            continue
        sp = _spans(new[i])
        a, b = sp[header.index(f["part"])]
        new[i] = new[i][:a] + str(f["scan_value"]) + new[i][b:]
        applied.append({"finding": f.get("id"), "file_row": f["file_row"], "part": f["part"],
                        "old": f.get("file_value"), "new": f["scan_value"]})
    out = "".join(new)
    name = "published file"
    diff = "".join(difflib.unified_diff(lines, new, fromfile=f"a/{name}", tofile=f"b/{name}", n=0))
    return out.encode("utf-8"), diff, applied


# ---- the model gateway the audit runs through --------------------------------------------------------------------

class _CountingCompletions:
    def __init__(self, inner, owner):
        self.inner, self.owner = inner, owner

    def create(self, **kw):
        self.owner._space()
        r = self.inner.create(**kw)
        self.owner._count(kw.get("model"), r.usage)
        return r


class _Counting:
    def __init__(self, client, owner):
        self.chat = type("Chat", (), {})()
        self.chat.completions = _CountingCompletions(client.chat.completions, owner)


class AuditGateway(Gateway):
    """The Gateway, with two additions the audit needs: call starts at least `min_interval` seconds apart even when
    several threads ask at once, and calls, tokens and cost counted by model."""

    def __init__(self, *a, **kw):
        super().__init__(*a, **kw)
        self.by_model: dict = {}
        self._lock = threading.Lock()
        self._start = threading.Lock()
        self._next = 0.0
        self.client = _Counting(self.client, self)

    def _count(self, model, usage):
        with self._lock:
            m = self.by_model.setdefault(model, {"calls": 0, "prompt_tokens": 0, "completion_tokens": 0, "cost": 0.0})
            m["calls"] += 1
            m["prompt_tokens"] += usage.prompt_tokens
            m["completion_tokens"] += usage.completion_tokens
            m["cost"] += price(model, usage.prompt_tokens, usage.completion_tokens)

    def _space(self):
        """Called just before a request is sent: wait until `min_interval` has passed since the last one was sent."""
        with self._start:
            wait = self._next - time.monotonic()
            if wait > 0:
                time.sleep(wait)
            self._next = time.monotonic() + self.min_interval

    def calls_by_model(self) -> dict:
        return {k: {**v, "cost": round(v["cost"], 4)} for k, v in sorted(self.by_model.items())}

"""Files a run leaves behind: `county.json` and `run.json`.

runs/<run_id>/<county>/county.json
  county, run_id, layout            names the county, the run and the layout ("matrix")
  pages     [{number, width, height, dpi}]   image size at the dpi the boxes use (200)

            status is accepted or cannot_verify when the run is closed; first_read is what the first read gave
  totals    [{page, block, direction, key, value, box}]    direction row (key = row kind), col (key = precinct), grand
  checks    [{kind, page, block, key, terms, printed, computed, ok, note}]    kind row | col | grand_col | grand_row;
            terms = [[page, block, row_kind, column], ...] (cell keys only; values are in cells and totals; a small
            total or a row total that is a term is keyed [page, block, 'col' | 'row', key])
  reader    the model that read the county; sample = the figures of the choice (row sums in the sample, failing, rate,
            whether its values were kept), or {skipped: true} when the model was named
  verdicts  [{sum, page, block, verdict, reason, entity}]    one per sum still failing after the loop;
            verdict document_inconsistent | cannot_verify
  events    [{ts, kind, payload}]    in order: item_start, decision, reread, check, status_change, refused, stop, item_end
  summary   sums failing before and after, cells re-read / changed / cannot_verify, model calls, tokens, metered cost,
            seconds (the figures of the close)
runs/<run_id>/run.json
  run_id, started, ended, commit, command, counties, model_calls, prompt_tokens, completion_tokens,
  metered_cost_estimate
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import json
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path

from PIL import Image

from . import checks

LAYOUT = "matrix"
GEO_DPI = 200


def _page_sizes(county, pages, root=None):
    from .render import page_png
    from .sources import DATA
    root = root or DATA
    out = []
    for n in pages:
        try:
            with Image.open(page_png(county, n, GEO_DPI, root)) as im:
                out.append({"number": n, "width": im.width, "height": im.height, "dpi": GEO_DPI})
        except Exception:
            out.append({"number": n, "width": None, "height": None, "dpi": GEO_DPI})
    return out


def fill_boxes(led, county, geo) -> int:
    """Give every cell that has no box one worked out from the ruled lines of its block (page 1's first block, the
    registered-voters and ballots-cast rows, was read without boxes). Returns how many were filled."""
    n = 0
    for c in led.cells(county):
        if c["x0"] is None and geo is not None:
            try:
                b = geo.cell_box(c["page"], c["block_id"], c["row_kind"], c["column"])
            except Exception:
                b = None
            if b:
                led.set_box(county, c["page"], c["block_id"], c["row_kind"], c["column"], b)
                n += 1
    return n


def write_county(run_dir, county, run_id, led, geo, summary, *, pages=None, data_root=None) -> Path:
    cells, totals = led.cells(county), led.totals(county)
    if pages is None:
        pages = sorted({c["page"] for c in cells})
    box = lambda c: [c[k] for k in ("x0", "y0", "x1", "y1")] if c["x0"] is not None else None
    seen, blocks = set(), []
    for c in cells:
        k = (c["page"], c["block_id"])
        if k not in seen:
            seen.add(k)
            bb = geo.block_box(*k) if geo else None
            blocks.append({"id": c["block_id"], "page": c["page"], "contest": c["contest"],
                           "candidate": c["candidate"], "box": list(bb) if bb else None})
    chs = [{"kind": ch.kind, "page": ch.page, "block": ch.block_id, "key": ch.key,
            "terms": [list(k) for k, _ in ch.terms], "printed": ch.printed, "computed": ch.computed, "ok": ch.ok,
            "note": ch.note} for ch in checks.all_checks(cells, totals)]
    evs = led.events(county)
    chosen = next((json.loads(e["payload_json"]) for e in reversed(evs) if e["kind"] == "choose_reader"), None)
    tbox = lambda t: (lambda b: list(b) if b else None)(
        geo.total_box(t["page"], t["block_id"], t["direction"], t["key"]) if geo else None)
    d = {"county": county, "run_id": run_id, "layout": LAYOUT,
         "pages": _page_sizes(county, pages, data_root) if pages else [],
         "blocks": blocks,
         "cells": [{"page": c["page"], "block": c["block_id"], "contest": c["contest"], "candidate": c["candidate"],
                    "row_kind": c["row_kind"], "column": c["column"], "value": c["value"],
                    "first_read": c["first_read"], "status": c["status"], "tries": c["tries"], "model": c["model"],
                    "reason": c.get("reason"), "box": box(c)} for c in cells],
         "totals": [{"page": t["page"], "block": t["block_id"], "direction": t["direction"], "key": t["key"],

# ---- the audit's files -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

CROP_MAX_W = 2000
LABEL_W = 270      # the candidate's name and the row labels, left of the first column, at 200 dpi
CROP_DPI = 300


def group_crop(png, block_box, boxes, caption, dest, dpi=CROP_DPI) -> Path:
    """One picture per group: the block's label strip and the columns around the marked cells, the cells outlined,
    a caption above; at most 2000 px wide. Boxes and block_box are pixels at 200 dpi; `png` is the page at `dpi`."""
    from PIL import ImageDraw, ImageFont
    k = dpi / GEO_DPI
    bx0, by0, bx1, by1 = block_box
    with Image.open(png) as im:
        im = im.convert("RGB")
        d = ImageDraw.Draw(im)
        for x0, y0, x1, y1 in boxes:
            d.rectangle([x0 * k, y0 * k, x1 * k, y1 * k], outline=(220, 0, 0), width=4)
        if boxes:
            lo, hi = min(b[0] for b in boxes) - 110, max(b[2] for b in boxes) + 110
        else:
            lo, hi = bx0, bx1
        lo, hi = max(bx0, lo), min(bx1, hi)
        label = im.crop((round(bx0 * k), round(by0 * k), round((bx0 + LABEL_W) * k), round(by1 * k)))
        if lo <= bx0 + LABEL_W:
            body = im.crop((round(bx0 * k), round(by0 * k), round(hi * k), round(by1 * k)))
            pic = body
        else:
            body = im.crop((round(lo * k), round(by0 * k), round(hi * k), round(by1 * k)))
            pic = Image.new("RGB", (label.width + 12 + body.width, label.height), (255, 255, 255))
            pic.paste(label, (0, 0))
            pic.paste(body, (label.width + 12, 0))
    cap_h = 34
    out = Image.new("RGB", (pic.width, pic.height + cap_h), (255, 255, 255))
    out.paste(pic, (0, cap_h))
    try:
        font = ImageFont.load_default(size=20)
    except TypeError:
        font = ImageFont.load_default()
    ImageDraw.Draw(out).text((8, 6), caption, fill=(0, 0, 0), font=font)
    if out.width > CROP_MAX_W:
        out = out.resize((CROP_MAX_W, round(out.height * CROP_MAX_W / out.width)), Image.LANCZOS)
    dest.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    out.save(dest)
    return dest


def make_group_crops(county, res, geo, data_root=None) -> int:
    """Write crops/<group id>.png for each group and put its path on the group and its findings."""
    from .render import page_png
    from .sources import DATA
    n = 0
    for g in res["groups"]:
        fs = [f for f in res["findings"] if f["group"] == g["id"]]
        boxes = [tuple(f["box"]) for f in fs if f.get("box")]
        if g["page"] is None:
            continue
        try:
            bb = geo.block_box(g["page"], g["block"]) if geo else None
            if bb is None and boxes:
                bb = (min(b[0] for b in boxes) - LABEL_W, min(b[1] for b in boxes) - 20,
                      max(b[2] for b in boxes) + 110, max(b[3] for b in boxes) + 40)
            if bb is None:
                continue
            cap = (f"page {g['page']}, block {g['block']}: {g['candidate'] or g['office']} ({g['office']}"
                   f"{', ' + g['district'] if g['district'] else ''}), precinct {', '.join(g['precincts'])}; "
                   f"scan, cells outlined")
            png = page_png(county, g["page"], CROP_DPI, data_root or DATA)
            group_crop(png, bb, boxes, cap, res["crop_dir"] / f"{g['id']}.png")
            g["crop"] = f"crops/{g['id']}.png"
            for f in fs:
                f["crop"] = g["crop"]
            n += 1
        except Exception:                                   # a picture is evidence, not the finding: go on without it
            continue
    return n


def _count(items, key, order):
    return {k: sum(1 for i in items if i[key] == k) for k in order if any(i[key] == k for i in items)}


def write_findings(run_dir, county, run_id, res, *, policy, raw_file, file_name, file_urls, verdicts=()) -> dict:
    """findings.json, corrected/<file>, changes.diff and report.md next to county.json. Returns the corrections."""
    from . import audit
    out = Path(run_dir) / county
    out.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    fs = res["findings"]
    new, diff, applied = audit.apply_corrections(raw_file, fs)
    done = {a["finding"] for a in applied}
    for f in fs:
        f["corrected"] = f["id"] in done
    (out / "corrected").mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    (out / "corrected" / file_name).write_bytes(new)
    diff = diff.replace("a/published file", f"a/{file_name}").replace("b/published file", f"b/corrected/{file_name}")
    (out / "changes.diff").write_text(diff)
    m = res["matching"]
    d = {"county": county, "run_id": run_id, "file": file_name, "policy": policy,
         "counts": {"findings": len(fs), "by_kind": _count(fs, "kind", audit.KINDS),
                    "by_status": _count(fs, "status", audit.STATUSES), "groups": len(res["groups"]),
                    "corrections": len(applied)},
         "findings": fs, "groups": res["groups"], "corrections": applied,
         "unmatched": {"scan": m.unmatched_scan, "file": m.unmatched_file, "rejected": m.rejected, "model": m.model},
         "corrected_events": res["corrected_events"], "audit": res["audit"]}
    (out / "findings.json").write_text(json.dumps(d, indent=1))
    (out / "report.md").write_text(report_text(d, verdicts, file_urls))
    return d


def _sum_line(s) -> str:
    w = "holds" if s["holds_with_scan"] else "does not hold"
    f = "holds" if s["holds_with_file"] else "does not hold"
    return (f"  - {s['name']}: printed {s['printed']}; with the scan's value the cells add to {s['computed_with_scan']} "
            f"({w}); with the file's value they add to {s['computed_with_file']} ({f}).")


def report_text(d, verdicts, urls) -> str:
    """report.md in plain words. Counts, one section per group, then what could not be verified."""
    c = d["counts"]
    L = [f"# Crossfoot audit: {d['county'].replace('_', ' ').title()} County, run {d['run_id']}", "",
         "The published spreadsheet was copied from a scanned canvass. This audit compares the two. What it finds are "
         "transcription slips in a volunteer dataset; the county's scan is the source. Each finding is proved with the "
         "totals printed on the scan itself. No finding has been confirmed by a person.", "",
         f"- Scan: {urls['scan']}", f"- Published file: {urls['file']}", "",
         "## Counts", "", f"{c['findings']} findings in {c['groups']} groups; {c['corrections']} values changed in the "
         "corrected file.", "", "| kind | findings |", "|---|---|"]
    L += [f"| {k} | {v} |" for k, v in c["by_kind"].items()] or ["| none | 0 |"]
    L += ["", "| status | findings |", "|---|---|"] + ([f"| {k} | {v} |" for k, v in c["by_status"].items()] or ["| none | 0 |"])
    p = d["policy"]
    L += ["", f"Where the scan disagrees with itself, the answer in use is '{p['answer']}' ({p['meaning']}); "
          f"answered by: {p['answered_by']}. It never changes a value; only a printed total that decides can.", ""]
    by = {f["id"]: f for f in d["findings"]}
    L += ["## Groups", ""]
    for g in d["groups"]:
        place = f"{g['office']}{', ' + g['district'] if g['district'] else ''}"
        L += [f"### {g['id']}: {g['kind']}, {g['candidate'] or g['office']}, precinct {', '.join(g['precincts'])}", "",
              f"{place}. Page {g['page']}, block {g['block']}. Statuses: " +
              ", ".join(f"{k} {v}" for k, v in g["statuses"].items()) + ".", ""]
        if g["crop"]:
            L += [f"![{g['id']}]({g['crop']})", ""]
        for fid in g["findings"]:
            f = by[fid]
            fv = "no row" if f["file_value"] is None else f["file_value"]
            sv = "no row" if f["scan_value"] is None else f["scan_value"]
            L += [f"- Precinct {f['precinct']}, {f['part']}: the file has {fv}, the scan has {sv}. "
                  f"Status {f['status']}: {f['reason']}" + (" Changed in the corrected file." if f["corrected"] else "")]
            L += [_sum_line(s) for s in f["sums"]]
            if f["reread"] and f["reread"]["value"] is not None:
                L += [f"  - Looked at the scan again ({f['reread']['model']}, {f['reread']['dpi']} dpi): it reads "
                      f"{f['reread']['value']}."]
        L += [""]
    L += ["## What could not be verified, and why", ""]
    open_ = [f for f in d["findings"] if f["status"] != "settled_against_file"]
    if not open_:
        L += ["Every finding is settled by a printed total.", ""]
    for f in open_:
        L += [f"- {f['id']} (group {f['group']}), {f['candidate'] or f['office']}, precinct {f['precinct']}, "
              f"{f['part']}: {f['status']}. {f['reason']}"]
    u = d["unmatched"]
    for v in verdicts:
        L += [f"- The ledger itself: {v.get('sum_id') or v.get('sum')} ended {v['verdict']}. {v['reason']}"]
    if u["scan"] or u["file"] or u["rejected"]:
        L += ["", "Not matched between the scan and the file, so not compared:"]
        L += [f"- scan block {x['block']}: {x['contest']}, {x['candidate']}" for x in u["scan"]]
        L += [f"- file: {x['contest']} {x['district']}, {x['candidate']} ({x['rows']} rows)" for x in u["file"]]
        L += [f"- rejected pairing, {x['what']}: {x['why']}" for x in u["rejected"]]
    L += [""]
    return "\n".join(L)


def write_audit_run(run_dir, run_id, *, started, ended, seconds, command, county, gw, reader, sample, resumed_from,
                    phases, spend=None) -> Path:
    """One run.json for the whole `audit` command."""
    d = {"run_id": run_id, "started": started, "ended": ended, "seconds": seconds, "commit": git_commit(),
         "command": command, "counties": [county], "resumed_from": resumed_from, "reader": reader,
         "sample": sample, "phases_seconds": phases, "model_calls": gw.calls,
         "model_calls_by_model": gw.calls_by_model(), "prompt_tokens": gw.prompt_tokens,
         "completion_tokens": gw.completion_tokens, "metered_cost_estimate": round(gw.cost, 4)}
    if spend:
        d["gateway_spend"] = spend
    out = Path(run_dir) / "run.json"
    out.write_text(json.dumps(d, indent=1))
    return out


def git_commit() -> str | None:
    try:
        return subprocess.run(["git", "rev-parse", "HEAD"], capture_output=True, text=True, check=True).stdout.strip()
    except (OSError, subprocess.CalledProcessError):
        return None


def write_run(run_dir, run_id, *, started, ended, command, counties, gw, resumed_from=None) -> Path:
    d = {"run_id": run_id, "started": started, "ended": ended, "commit": git_commit(), "command": command,
         "counties": counties, "resumed_from": resumed_from, "model_calls": gw.calls,
         "prompt_tokens": gw.prompt_tokens, "completion_tokens": gw.completion_tokens,
         "metered_cost_estimate": round(gw.cost, 4)}
    out = Path(run_dir) / "run.json"
    out.write_text(json.dumps(d, indent=1))
    return out

"""The audit's rules: status of a disagreement from the printed sums, and the corrected file (AC-7). No network."""
import csv
import io
import re

from PIL import Image

from crossfoot import audit
from crossfoot.ledger import Ledger
from tests.test_agent import GOOD, make_block

HEAD = "county,precinct,office,district,party,candidate,votes,absentee,early_voting,election_day"


def sm(name, scan, file):
    return {"name": name, "holds_with_scan": scan, "holds_with_file": file}


# ---- status rules --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

def test_settled_when_a_total_holds_with_the_scan_and_fails_with_the_file():
    st, why = audit.decide_status([sm("row", True, False), sm("col", True, False)])
    assert st == "settled_against_file"


def test_a_sum_that_fails_with_both_values_decides_nothing():
    st, why = audit.decide_status([sm("row", True, False), sm("grand", True, False), sm("x", False, False)])
    assert st == "settled_against_file" and "decide nothing" in why


def test_not_settled_when_a_total_holds_with_the_file_and_fails_with_the_scan():
    st, why = audit.decide_status([sm("row", True, False), sm("col", False, True)])
    assert st == "document_inconsistent"
    assert "row" in why and "col" in why            # names which totals disagree


def test_cannot_verify_when_no_total_decides():
    assert audit.decide_status([sm("a", False, False)])[0] == "cannot_verify"
    assert audit.decide_status([sm("a", True, True)])[0] == "cannot_verify"
    assert audit.decide_status([])[0] == "cannot_verify"


def test_cannot_verify_when_the_scan_value_breaks_every_sum_and_the_file_holds_one():
    st, why = audit.decide_status([sm("a", False, True), sm("b", False, False)])
    assert st == "cannot_verify" and "doubt" in why


def test_cannot_verify_when_the_scan_value_is_in_doubt():
    st, why = audit.decide_status([sm("a", True, False)], doubt="the re-read gave a third value")
    assert st == "cannot_verify" and "third value" in why


# ---- AC-7: the corrected file --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

def file_text(rows):
    return HEAD + "\n" + "".join(",".join(r) + "\n" for r in rows)


def parse(text):
    return list(csv.DictReader(io.StringIO(text)))


def finding(row, part, new, status="settled_against_file", kind="wrong_number", scan_value=None):
    return {"file_row": row, "part": part, "file_value": 0, "scan_value": new if scan_value is None else scan_value,
            "kind": kind, "status": status}


def test_only_settled_findings_change_the_file_and_the_diff_has_exactly_those_lines():
    rows = [["X", "1", "C", "", "REP", "A", "15", "2", "10", "3"],
            ["X", "2", "C", "", "REP", "A", "31", "4", "21", "6"],
            ["X", "3", "C", "", "REP", "A", "9", "1", "4", "4"]]
    raw = file_text(rows).encode()
    fs = [finding(1, "early_voting", 20), finding(1, "votes", 30),
          finding(2, "absentee", 7, status="cannot_verify"),
          finding(2, "election_day", 5, status="document_inconsistent")]
    new, diff, applied = audit.apply_corrections(raw, fs)
    assert len(applied) == 2
    old_l, new_l = raw.decode().splitlines(True), new.decode().splitlines(True)
    assert [i for i, (a, b) in enumerate(zip(old_l, new_l)) if a != b] == [2]      # only precinct 2's line
    assert old_l[:2] + old_l[3:] == new_l[:2] + new_l[3:]                          # every other byte is kept
    assert new_l[2] == "X,2,C,,REP,A,30,4,20,6\n"
    assert diff.count("\n-X,") == 1 and diff.count("\n+X,") == 1
    assert diff.startswith("--- a/") and "@@" in diff


def test_a_correction_needs_a_scan_value_and_a_settled_finding():
    raw = file_text([["X", "1", "C", "", "REP", "A", "15", "2", "10", "3"]]).encode()
    fs = [finding(0, "votes", None, scan_value=None, kind="extra_row"),
          finding(0, "absentee", 9, kind="missing_row", status="cannot_verify")]
    fs[0]["scan_value"] = None
    new, diff, applied = audit.apply_corrections(raw, fs)
    assert new == raw and diff == "" and applied == []


def test_a_quoted_field_and_crlf_lines_are_kept():
    line = 'X,2,"Justice, Place 2",,REP,A,31,4,21,6\r\n'
    raw = (HEAD + "\r\n" + line).encode()
    new, diff, applied = audit.apply_corrections(raw, [finding(0, "votes", 30)])
    assert new.decode() == HEAD + "\r\n" + 'X,2,"Justice, Place 2",,REP,A,30,4,21,6\r\n'
    assert len(applied) == 1


def test_end_to_end_small_file_and_ledger(tmp_path):
    led = Ledger()
    make_block(led, 1, "p1-b1")                       # precincts 1 and 2; EARLY row total 30, small totals 15 and 30
    rows = [["X", "1", "C", "", "", "cand p1-b1", "15", "2", "10", "3"],
            ["X", "2", "C", "", "", "cand p1-b1", "30", "4", "21", "6"]]    # precinct 2 early_voting 21, should be 20
    raw = file_text(rows).encode()
    res = audit.audit_county("x", led, Geo(), Gw(led), parse(raw.decode()), run_dir=tmp_path, make_crops=False,
                             log=lambda *a: None)
    fs = res["findings"]
    assert [(f["precinct"], f["part"], f["file_value"], f["scan_value"], f["kind"], f["status"],
             f["confirmed_by_person"]) for f in fs] == [
        ("2", "early_voting", 21, 20, "wrong_number", "settled_against_file", False),
        ("2", "votes", 30, 30, "file_row_fails_own_total", "cannot_verify", False)]   # 4 + 21 + 6 is not 30
    sums = {s["name"]: s for s in fs[0]["sums"]}
    assert all(s["holds_with_scan"] and not s["holds_with_file"] for s in sums.values()) and len(sums) == 2
    new, diff, applied = audit.apply_corrections(raw, fs)
    assert len(applied) == 1
    assert new.decode().splitlines(True)[2] == "X,2,C,,,cand p1-b1,30,4,20,6\n"
    assert new.decode().splitlines(True)[:2] == raw.decode().splitlines(True)[:2]


class Geo:
    def crop(self, page, bid, target, dpi, dest):
        dest.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        Image.new("L", (10, 10), 255).save(dest)
        return dest, (0, 0, 10, 10)

    def cell_box(self, page, bid, row, col):
        return None

    def total_box(self, page, bid, direction, key):
        return None

    def block_box(self, page, bid):
        return None


class Gw:
    """Answers a single-value re-read with what the ledger holds (the scan shows what the first read said)."""
    model = "claude-sonnet-4.6"
    calls = prompt_tokens = completion_tokens = 0
    cost = 0.0

    def __init__(self, led, says=None):
        self.cells = {(c["row_kind"], c["column"]): c["value"] for c in led.cells("x")}      # read here: sqlite is
        self.totals = {t["key"]: t["value"] for t in led.totals("x") if t["direction"] == "col"}   # per thread
        self.says, self.asked = says, []

    def ask_json(self, prompt, image=None, *, validate=None, model=None):
        self.asked.append((prompt, model))
        m = re.search(r"cell of precinct (\S+),\s*row (\w+)", prompt, re.S)
        if m:
            col, row = m.group(1).rstrip(","), m.group(2)
            v = self.cells[(row, col)]
        else:
            col = re.search(r"under precinct (\S+?)[ .]", prompt).group(1)
            v = self.totals[col]
        if self.says:
            v = self.says(row if m else "votes", col, v)
        ans = {"value": v}
        if validate:
            validate(ans)
        return ans

def test_labels_are_normalised():
    assert audit.candidate_key("Jill Stein/Rudolph Ware (GRN)") == audit.candidate_key("Jill Stein")
    assert audit.candidate_key("Jeff Rambin [REP]") == "jefframbin"
    assert audit.candidate_key("R.C. (Cutter) Clinton (REP)") == audit.candidate_key("R.C. (Cutter) Clinton")
    assert "countycommissioner3" in audit.contest_keys("County Commissioner, Precinct No. 3")
    assert audit.nk("Rail-road Commissioner") == audit.nk("Railroad Commissioner")


class FakeFileGw:

        self.answer, self.prompts = answer, []

    def ask_json(self, prompt, image=None, *, validate=None, model=None):
        self.prompts.append(prompt)
        validate(self.answer)
        return self.answer

    rows = [{"office": "Senate", "district": "", "candidate": "cand p1-b1", "precinct": "1", "votes": "15"},

def _latest_closed_run() -> str | None:
    from pathlib import Path
    runs = sorted(p.parent.parent.name for p in Path("runs").glob("*/*/county.json") if (p.parent.parent / "ledger.sqlite").exists())
    return runs[-1] if runs else None


def cmd_audit(args) -> int:
    import json
    import shutil
    import time
    from pathlib import Path

    from . import agent, audit, outputs, policy, tracing
    from .layouts import matrix
    from .ledger import Ledger
    from .model import BudgetExceeded, gateway_spend
    from .render import RenderError
    if args.county != "panola":
        print(f"{args.county}: only the matrix layout (panola) is built so far", file=sys.stderr)
        return 1
    src = None
    if args.resume:
        resume = _latest_closed_run() if args.resume == "latest" else args.resume
        src = Path("runs") / str(resume) / "ledger.sqlite"
        if not resume or not src.exists():
            print(f"no closed run to resume from ({src})", file=sys.stderr)
            return 1
    try:
        sources.fetch(args.county)
    except sources.FetchError as e:
        print(e, file=sys.stderr)
        return 1
    note = tracing.init()
    if note:
        print(note)
    try:
        before = gateway_spend()[0]
    except (KeyError, OSError, ValueError):
        before = None
    t0 = time.time()
    started = time.strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S")
    run_id = time.strftime("%Y%m%d-%H%M%S")
    out = Path("runs") / run_id
    out.mkdir(parents=True)
    log = lambda *a: print(*a, flush=True)
    phases, sample, summary, stopped, reader = {}, None, None, None, None
    gw = audit.AuditGateway(budget=args.budget)
    try:
        if src:
            shutil.copy(src, out / "ledger.sqlite")           # the run resumed from is never changed
            led = Ledger(out / "ledger.sqlite")
            src_json = src.parent / args.county / "county.json"
            if src_json.exists():
                old = json.loads(src_json.read_text())
                summary, sample = old.get("summary"), old.get("sample")
            print(f"run {run_id}: auditing {args.county} on the ledger of {src.parent.name} (no new read)")
        else:
            led = Ledger(out / "ledger.sqlite")
            print(f"run {run_id}: reading, closing and auditing {args.county}, run budget ${args.budget:.2f}")
            t1 = time.time()
            s_read = matrix.read_county(args.county, gw, led, run_id=run_id, model="auto", log=log)
            phases["read"] = round(time.time() - t1, 1)
            sample = s_read.get("sample")
            if s_read["stopped"]:
                print(s_read["stopped"], file=sys.stderr)
                return 2
        cols = matrix.precinct_order(led, args.county)
        if not cols:
            print("the ledger has no header block (registered voters row); nothing to place columns by", file=sys.stderr)
            return 1
        geo = matrix.Geometry(args.county, cols)
        chosen = next((json.loads(e["payload_json"]) for e in reversed(led.events(args.county))
                       if e["kind"] == "choose_reader"), None)
        reader = (chosen or {}).get("reader") or "claude-haiku"
        sample = sample or chosen
        gw.model = reader
        t1 = time.time()
        closed = agent.close_county(args.county, gw, led, geo, run_id=run_id, reader=reader, log=log)
        agent.finalize_open(led, args.county)
        phases["close"] = round(time.time() - t1, 1)
        summary = dict(summary if src and summary else closed)
        cs = led.cells(args.county)
        summary.update(cells_accepted=sum(c["status"] == "accepted" for c in cs),
                       cells_cannot_verify=sum(c["status"] == "cannot_verify" for c in cs),
                       cells_document_inconsistent=sum(c["status"] == "document_inconsistent" for c in cs),
                       cells_open=sum(c["status"] not in ("accepted", "cannot_verify", "document_inconsistent")
                                      for c in cs))
        stopped = closed["stopped"]
        if not stopped:
            outputs.fill_boxes(led, args.county, geo)
            t1 = time.time()
            pol = policy.write_for_run(out)
            rows = sources.read_published(args.county)
            fname = sources.file_url(args.county).rsplit("/", 1)[1]
            raw = sources.file_path(args.county).read_bytes()
            res = audit.audit_county(args.county, led, geo, gw, rows, run_dir=out, log=log, run_id=run_id, file_name=fname)
            phases["audit"] = round(time.time() - t1, 1)
            outputs.make_group_crops(args.county, res, geo)
            outputs.write_county(out, args.county, run_id, led, geo, summary)
            d = outputs.write_findings(out, args.county, run_id, res, policy=pol, raw_file=raw, file_name=fname,
                                       file_urls={"scan": sources.scan_url(args.county), "file": sources.file_url(args.county)},
                                       verdicts=led.verdicts(args.county))
    except BudgetExceeded as e:
        stopped = str(e)
        print(f"stopped: {e}", file=sys.stderr)
    except RenderError as e:
        print(e, file=sys.stderr)
        return 1
    finally:
        tracing.shutdown()
    spend = None
    try:
        after = gateway_spend()[0]
        spend = {"before": before, "after": after, "change": round(after - before, 4)}
    except (KeyError, OSError, ValueError, TypeError):
        pass
    seconds = round(time.time() - t0, 1)
    outputs.write_audit_run(out, run_id, started=started, ended=time.strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S"), seconds=seconds,
                            command="crossfoot " + " ".join(sys.argv[1:]), county=args.county, gw=gw,
                            reader=reader, sample=sample, resumed_from=(src.parent.name if src else None),
                            phases=phases, spend=spend)
    if stopped:
        print("the run stopped before the audit finished; nothing was written beyond run.json", file=sys.stderr)
        return 2
    c = d["counts"]
    print(f"reader: {reader}; findings: {c['findings']} in {c['groups']} groups; by kind {c['by_kind']}; by status "
          f"{c['by_status']}; values changed in the corrected file: {c['corrections']}")
    print(f"ledger values corrected by a re-read: {d['audit']['ledger_corrected']}; re-reads: {d['audit']['rereads']}")
    print(f"model calls: {gw.calls} {gw.calls_by_model()}; tokens: {gw.prompt_tokens} in, {gw.completion_tokens} out; "
          f"metered cost (estimate): ${gw.cost:.4f}; seconds: {seconds}")
    if spend:
        print(f"gateway spend: ${spend['before']:.4f} -> ${spend['after']:.4f} (change ${spend['change']:.4f})")
    print(f"written: {out / args.county}/ (findings.json, report.md, changes.diff, corrected/, crops/), {out / 'run.json'}")
    return 0


def cmd_verify_known(args) -> int:
    import json
    from pathlib import Path
    known = Path("tests") / f"known_{args.county}.json"
    runs = sorted(p for p in Path("runs").glob(f"*/{args.county}/findings.json"))
    if not known.exists() or not runs:
        print(f"need {known} and a run with {args.county}/findings.json", file=sys.stderr)
        return 1
